## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\dashboard-id3\dashboard-id3.scss

```typescript
// =====================================================================
// Dashboard de Ventas (dashboardId3) — /facturacion/dashboardId3
// =====================================================================

.page.dash3 {
  gap: 0.875rem;
}

.hdr-periodo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 0.1rem;

  .hdr-periodo-valor {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--c-text);
  }

  .hdr-periodo-sub {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }
}

// ===== Filtros (mismo patrón de 3 filas de los históricos) =====
.filtros {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  width: 100%;

  .filtros-fila {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 16rem));
    gap: 1rem;
    align-items: end;
    justify-content: start;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .campo {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    min-width: 0;

    label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--c-text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }
  }

  .filtros-acciones {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .filtros .filtros-fila {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .filtros .filtros-fila {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

// ===== Tarjetas KPI =====
.kpis {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.kpi {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  min-width: 0;

  .kpi-label {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }

  .kpi-valor {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--c-text);
    line-height: 1.15;
    word-break: break-word;

    &.negativo {
      color: var(--c-error);
    }
  }

  .kpi-sub {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
}

.kpi--contado {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--c-success, #10b981);
}

.kpi--credito {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--c-warning, #f59e0b);
}

.kpi--alerta {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--c-error, #ef4444);
}

.kpi--ok {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--c-success, #10b981);
}

@media (max-width: 1400px) {
  .kpis {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .kpis {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

// ===== Widgets =====
.grid-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.875rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.widget {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 0;

  .widget-hdr {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);

    h3 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-text);
    }
  }

  .widget-nota {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }

  .widget-body {
    padding: 1rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
}

.split-a {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.split-b {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
}

.split-d {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .grid-2,
  .split-a,
  .split-b,
  .split-d {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

// ===== Charts =====
.chart-box {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 300px;
}

.chart-box--square {
  height: 260px;
}

.chart-box--vendedor {
  height: 260px;
}

.chart-box--meses {
  height: 330px;
}

.chart-box--pareto {
  height: 300px;
}

.chart-box--alt {
  height: 240px;
}

// ===== Mini tarjetas (widget A) =====
.mini-lista {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.mini {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.15rem;
  background: var(--c-surface-ground);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;

  .mini-label {
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }

  .mini-valor {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--c-text);
  }

  .mini-sub {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }
}

.mini--contado {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--c-success, #10b981);
}

.mini--credito {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--c-warning, #f59e0b);
}

// ===== Utilidad bruta (widget E) =====
.utilidad-block {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;

  .mini-label {
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }

  .utilidad-valor {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--c-text);
    line-height: 1.2;

    &.negativo {
      color: var(--c-error);
    }

    &--sm {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }
  }

  .utilidad-monto,
  .utilidad-margen {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    background: var(--c-surface-ground);
    border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .utilidad-block {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

// ===== Badges de variación (widget C) =====
.badges {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.badge {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-surface-ground);
  color: var(--c-text);

  &.positivo {
    color: var(--c-success, #10b981);
    border-color: var(--c-success, #10b981);
  }

  &.negativo {
    color: var(--c-error, #ef4444);
    border-color: var(--c-error, #ef4444);
  }

  &.neutro {
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }
}

// ===== Tablas =====
.tabla-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.tabla-wrap--scroll {
  max-height: 420px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.8rem;

  th,
  td {
    padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;
    text-align: left;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  thead th {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    background: var(--c-surface-ground);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }

  tbody tr:hover {
    background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05);
  }

  tfoot td {
    border-bottom: none;
    background: var(--c-surface-ground);
  }

  .num {
    text-align: right;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  .muted {
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }

  .vacio-fila {
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
    padding: 1.25rem;
  }
}

.fila-vencida td {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.06);
}

.dormido td {
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.prod-desc {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.prod-cod {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.nota-pie {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.cobranza-kpis {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .cobranza-kpis {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

// ===== Estados =====
.vacio {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  border: 1px dashed var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.cargando {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 3rem 1rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\dashboard-id3\dashboard-id3.ts

```typescript
﻿import {
  Component,
  OnInit,
  OnDestroy,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  DestroyRef,
  Injector,
  inject,
  signal,
  computed,
  effect,
  afterNextRender,
} from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Chart, registerables, ChartConfiguration } from 'chart.js';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { FacturacionService } from '../../../core/services/facturacion.service';
import {
  DashboardVentas,
  OpcionSel,
} from '../../../core/models/facturacion.models';

Chart.register(...registerables);

const MESES = [
  'Enero', 'Febrero', 'Marzo', 'Abril', 'Mayo', 'Junio',
  'Julio', 'Agosto', 'Septiembre', 'Octubre', 'Noviembre', 'Diciembre',
];

/** Colores de las series (coherentes con los tokens --c-* del tema). */
const C = {
  contado: '#10b981',
  credito: '#f59e0b',
  acumulado: '#3b82f6',
  ventas: '#10b981',
  vendedor: '#10b981',
  vendedorAlt: '#6ee7b7',
  margen: '#10b981',
  margenBajo: '#ef4444',
  pareto: '#10b981',
  paretoLinea: '#f59e0b',
  eje: '#64748b',
  rejilla: '#e2e8f0',
};

/**
 * Dashboard de Facturación (KPIs de ventas) — ruta `/facturacion/dashboardId3`.
 *
 * 7 componentes (chart.js puro, sin ng2-charts):
 *  A. Ventas al Contado vs. Crédito (doughnut + 2 tarjetas KPI)
 *  B. Ventas por Vendedor (barras horizontales + tabla de ticket/participación)
 *  C. Ventas por Meses — ventana de 12 meses con MoM y YoY (barras apiladas + línea acumulada)
 *  D. Facturas vencidas / Antigüedad de Saldos (AR Aging) + DSO
 *  E. Utilidad Bruta (ventas − COGS) y margen % por categoría
 *  F. Top 25 productos con diagrama de Pareto (acumulado al 80%)
 *  G. Bottom 25 productos (baja rotación / "dormidos")
 *
 * Filtros interactivos: Año, Mes, Sucursal/Canal y Categoría de producto.
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-dashboard-id3',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, SelectModule, ButtonModule, TooltipModule],
  templateUrl: './dashboard-id3.html',
  styleUrl: './dashboard-id3.scss',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class DashboardId3Component implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private facturacion = inject(FacturacionService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private injector = inject(Injector);

  readonly datos = signal<DashboardVentas | null>(null);
  readonly cargando = signal(false);

  // ===== Filtros =====
  readonly anioSel = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly mesSel = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly sucursalSel = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly categoriaSel = signal<number | null>(null);

  readonly anioOps = signal<OpcionSel[]>([]);
  readonly mesOps = signal<OpcionSel[]>([]);
  readonly sucursalOps = signal<OpcionSel[]>([]);
  readonly categoriaOps = signal<OpcionSel[]>([]);

  // ===== Estados vacíos =====
  readonly tieneVentas = computed(() => (this.datos()?.resumen.ventasTotales ?? 0) > 0);
  readonly tieneVendedores = computed(() => (this.datos()?.vendedores.length ?? 0) > 0);
  readonly tieneCategorias = computed(() => (this.datos()?.categoriaMargen.length ?? 0) > 0);
  readonly tieneTop = computed(() =>
    (this.datos()?.topProductos ?? []).some((p) => p.ingresos > 0),
  );
  readonly tienePareto = computed(() => this.tieneTop());
  readonly tieneCartera = computed(() => (this.datos()?.aging.carteraTotal ?? 0) > 0);

  private charts: Chart[] = [];

  /** Tras cada carga: pinta los canvas y (re)crea los charts. */
  private _render = effect(() => {
    const d = this.datos();
    if (!d) return;
    afterNextRender(() => this.renderizar(d), { injector: this.injector });
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.mesOps.set([
      { label: 'Todo el año', value: null },
      ...MESES.map((m, i) => ({ label: m, value: i + 1 })),
    ]);
    this.cargar();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destruirCharts();
  }

  cargar(): void {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.facturacion
      .getDashboardVentas({
        anio: this.anioSel(),
        mes: this.mesSel(),
        sucursalId: this.sucursalSel(),
        categoriaId: this.categoriaSel(),
      })
      .pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef))
      .subscribe({
        next: (d) => this.aplicar(d),
        error: () => this.cargando.set(false),
      });
  }

  buscar(): void {
    this.cargar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros(): void {
    this.anioSel.set(null);
    this.mesSel.set(null);
    this.sucursalSel.set(null);
    this.categoriaSel.set(null);
    this.cargar();
  }

  private aplicar(d: DashboardVentas): void {
    this.datos.set(d);
    this.cargando.set(false);

    const anios: OpcionSel[] = [{ label: 'Todos', value: null }];
    const disponibles = d.opciones.anios?.length ? d.opciones.anios : [d.referencia.anio];
    for (const a of [...new Set(disponibles)].sort((x, y) => y - x)) {
      anios.push({ label: String(a), value: a });
    }
    this.anioOps.set(anios);

    this.sucursalOps.set([
      { label: 'Todas las sucursales', value: null },
      ...d.opciones.sucursales.map((s) => ({ label: s.descripcion, value: s.Idsucursal })),
    ]);
    this.categoriaOps.set([
      { label: 'Todas las categorías', value: null },
      ...d.opciones.categorias.map((c) => ({ label: c.descripcion, value: c.categoriaId })),
    ]);
  }

  // ===== Formatos =====

  fmt(n: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (n == null) return '—';
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('es-HN', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(Number(n) || 0);
  }

  fmtEntero(n: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (n == null) return '—';
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('es-HN').format(Number(n) || 0);
  }

  pct(n: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (n == null) return '—';
    return `${new Intl.NumberFormat('es-HN', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 1,
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    }).format(Number(n) || 0)}%`;
  }

  /** Formato con signo para MoM/YoY (+12.5% / −8.0%). */
  pctSigno(n: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (n == null) return '—';
    const v = Number(n) || 0;
    return `${v > 0 ? '+' : ''}${this.pct(v)}`;
  }

  claseVariacion(n: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (n == null) return 'neutro';
    if (n > 0) return 'positivo';
    if (n < 0) return 'negativo';
    return 'neutro';
  }

  fecha(n: string | null): string {
    if (!n) return '—';
    const d = new Date(n);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
    return d.toLocaleDateString('es-HN');
  }

  /** % acumulado de ingresos del Top 25 hasta la fila `i` (solo filas con ingresos > 0). */
  acumuladoTop(i: number, d: DashboardVentas): string {
    const total = d.topProductos.reduce((s, p) => s + p.ingresos, 0);
    if (total <= 0) return '—';
    let acum = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k <= i; k++) acum += d.topProductos[k]?.ingresos ?? 0;
    return this.pct(Math.round((acum / total) * 1000) / 10);
  }

  /** Formato compacto para ejes (1.2M, 345K). */
  private compacto(n: number): string {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('es-HN', {
      notation: 'compact',
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    }).format(n);
  }

  // ===== Charts =====

  private canvas(id: string): HTMLCanvasElement | null {
    return document.getElementById(id) as HTMLCanvasElement | null;
  }

  private baseOptions(): ChartConfiguration['options'] {
    return {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: {
          labels: { boxWidth: 12, font: { size: 11 }, color: C.eje },
        },
      },
    };
  }

  private renderizar(d: DashboardVentas): void {
    this.destruirCharts();
    this.graficoContadoCredito(d);
    this.graficoVendedores(d);
    this.graficoMeses(d);
    this.graficoMargen(d);
    this.graficoPareto(d);
  }

  /** Widget A — doughnut Contado vs Crédito. */
  private graficoContadoCredito(d: DashboardVentas): void {
    const el = this.canvas('chartContadoCredito');
    if (!el) return;
    const cc = d.contadoCredito;
    if (cc.contado === 0 && cc.credito === 0) return;
    this.charts.push(
      new Chart(el, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
          labels: ['Contado', 'Crédito'],
          datasets: [
            {
              data: [cc.contado, cc.credito],
              backgroundColor: [C.contado, C.credito],
              borderColor: '#ffffff',
              borderWidth: 2,
            },
          ],
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          cutout: '58%',
          plugins: {
            legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { boxWidth: 12, font: { size: 11 }, color: C.eje } },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: (ctx) => {
                  const total = cc.contado + cc.credito;
                  const p = total > 0 ? (Number(ctx.parsed) / total) * 100 : 0;
                  return ` ${ctx.label}: ${this.fmt(Number(ctx.parsed))} (${this.pct(p)})`;
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      }),
    );
  }

  /** Widget B — barras horizontales de ventas por vendedor. */
  private graficoVendedores(d: DashboardVentas): void {
    const el = this.canvas('chartVendedores');
    if (!el || !d.vendedores.length) return;
    const v = d.vendedores;
    this.charts.push(
      new Chart(el, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: v.map((x) => x.nombre),
          datasets: [
            {
              label: 'Ventas',
              data: v.map((x) => x.ventas),
              backgroundColor: v.map((_, i) => (i % 2 === 0 ? C.vendedor : C.vendedorAlt)),
              borderRadius: 4,
            },
          ],
        },
        options: {
          ...this.baseOptions(),
          indexAxis: 'y',
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: (ctx) => {
                  const row = v[ctx.dataIndex];
                  return [
                    ` Ventas: ${this.fmt(row.ventas)}`,
                    ` Comprobantes: ${row.comprobantes}`,
                    ` Ticket promedio: ${this.fmt(row.ticketPromedio)}`,
                    ` Participación: ${this.pct(row.pctParticipacion)}`,
                  ];
                },
              },
            },
          },
          scales: {
            x: {
              ticks: { color: C.eje, font: { size: 10 }, callback: (val) => this.compacto(Number(val)) },
              grid: { color: C.rejilla },
            },
            y: { ticks: { color: C.eje, font: { size: 11 } }, grid: { display: false } },
          },
        },
      }),
    );
  }

  /** Widget C — barras apiladas Contado/Crédito + línea de acumulado en 12 meses. */
  private graficoMeses(d: DashboardVentas): void {
    const el = this.canvas('chartMeses');
    if (!el || !d.meses.length) return;
    this.charts.push(
      new Chart(el, {
        data: {
          labels: d.meses.map((m) => m.etiqueta),
          datasets: [
            {
              type: 'bar',
              label: 'Contado',
              data: d.meses.map((m) => m.contado),
              backgroundColor: C.contado,
              borderRadius: 3,
              stack: 's',
              yAxisID: 'y',
            },
            {
              type: 'bar',
              label: 'Crédito',
              data: d.meses.map((m) => m.credito),
              backgroundColor: C.credito,
              borderRadius: 3,
              stack: 's',
              yAxisID: 'y',
            },
            {
              type: 'line',
              label: 'Acumulado',
              data: d.meses.map((m) => m.acumulado),
              borderColor: C.acumulado,
              backgroundColor: C.acumulado,
              borderWidth: 2,
              pointRadius: 2,
              tension: 0.3,
              yAxisID: 'y1',
            },
          ],
        },
        options: {
          ...this.baseOptions(),
          plugins: {
            legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { boxWidth: 12, font: { size: 11 }, color: C.eje } },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: (ctx) => ` ${ctx.dataset.label}: ${this.fmt(Number(ctx.parsed.y))}`,
              },
            },
          },
          scales: {
            x: {
              stacked: true,
              ticks: { color: C.eje, font: { size: 10 } },
              grid: { display: false },
            },
            y: {
              stacked: true,
              position: 'left',
              ticks: { color: C.eje, font: { size: 10 }, callback: (v) => this.compacto(Number(v)) },
              grid: { color: C.rejilla },
            },
            y1: {
              position: 'right',
              ticks: { color: C.acumulado, font: { size: 10 }, callback: (v) => this.compacto(Number(v)) },
              grid: { display: false },
            },
          },
        },
      } as unknown as ChartConfiguration),
    );
  }

  /** Widget E — barras del margen bruto (%) por categoría. */
  private graficoMargen(d: DashboardVentas): void {
    const el = this.canvas('chartMargen');
    if (!el || !d.categoriaMargen.length) return;
    const cats = d.categoriaMargen;
    this.charts.push(
      new Chart(el, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: cats.map((c) => c.categoria),
          datasets: [
            {
              label: 'Margen bruto %',
              data: cats.map((c) => c.margen ?? 0),
              backgroundColor: cats.map((c) => ((c.margen ?? 0) >= 0 ? C.margen : C.margenBajo)),
              borderRadius: 4,
            },
          ],
        },
        options: {
          ...this.baseOptions(),
          indexAxis: 'y',
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: (ctx) => {
                  const c = cats[ctx.dataIndex];
                  return [
                    ` Margen: ${this.pct(c.margen)}`,
                    ` Ventas: ${this.fmt(c.ventas)}`,
                    ` COGS: ${this.fmt(c.cogs)}`,
                    ` Utilidad: ${this.fmt(c.utilidad)}`,
                  ];
                },
              },
            },
          },
          scales: {
            x: {
              ticks: { color: C.eje, font: { size: 10 }, callback: (v) => `${v}%` },
              grid: { color: C.rejilla },
            },
            y: { ticks: { color: C.eje, font: { size: 11 } }, grid: { display: false } },
          },
        },
      }),
    );
  }

  /** Widget F — Pareto: barras de ingresos por producto + línea de % acumulado. */
  private graficoPareto(d: DashboardVentas): void {
    const el = this.canvas('chartPareto');
    if (!el) return;
    const items = d.topProductos.filter((p) => p.ingresos > 0);
    if (!items.length) return;
    const total = items.reduce((s, p) => s + p.ingresos, 0);
    let acum = 0;
    const acumulado = items.map((p) => {
      acum += p.ingresos;
      return total > 0 ? Math.round((acum / total) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
    });
    this.charts.push(
      new Chart(el, {
        data: {
          labels: items.map((p) => p.descripcion),
          datasets: [
            {
              type: 'bar',
              label: 'Ingresos',
              data: items.map((p) => p.ingresos),
              backgroundColor: C.pareto,
              borderRadius: 3,
              yAxisID: 'y',
            },
            {
              type: 'line',
              label: '% acumulado',
              data: acumulado,
              borderColor: C.paretoLinea,
              backgroundColor: C.paretoLinea,
              borderWidth: 2,
              pointRadius: 2,
              tension: 0.2,
              yAxisID: 'y1',
            },
          ],
        },
        options: {
          ...this.baseOptions(),
          plugins: {
            legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { boxWidth: 12, font: { size: 11 }, color: C.eje } },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: (ctx) =>
                  ctx.dataset.yAxisID === 'y1'
                    ? ` Acumulado: ${this.pct(Number(ctx.parsed.y))}`
                    : ` Ingresos: ${this.fmt(Number(ctx.parsed.y))}`,
              },
            },
          },
          scales: {
            x: {
              ticks: { color: C.eje, font: { size: 10 }, maxRotation: 60, minRotation: 45 },
              grid: { display: false },
            },
            y: {
              ticks: { color: C.eje, font: { size: 10 }, callback: (v) => this.compacto(Number(v)) },
              grid: { color: C.rejilla },
            },
            y1: {
              position: 'right',
              min: 0,
              max: 100,
              ticks: { color: C.paretoLinea, font: { size: 10 }, callback: (v) => `${v}%` },
              grid: { display: false },
            },
          },
        },
      } as unknown as ChartConfiguration),
    );
  }

  private destruirCharts(): void {
    for (const chart of this.charts) chart.destroy();
    this.charts = [];
  }
}
```

```typescript
    path: 'todopago',
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./todopago/todopago').then((m) => m.TodoPago),
  },
  {
    path: 'restaurante',
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./restaurante/restaurante').then((m) => m.Restaurante),
  },
  { path: '**', redirectTo: 'consultas' },
];
```

```typescript
<section class="page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1 class="page-title">{{ titulo() }}</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">{{ config?.subtitulo }}</p>
    </div>
    <p-button label="Volver" icon="pi pi-arrow-left" severity="secondary" text size="small" rounded
      (onClick)="volver()" />
  </header>

  @if (cargando()) {
  <div class="card">Cargando datos...</div>
  } @else {
  <form [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="guardar()">
    <div class="card form-grid">
      @for (c of camposMae; track c.key) {
      @if (!c.oculto) {
      <div class="campo">
        <label [for]="c.key">{{ c.label }} @if (c.requerido) {<span class="req">*</span>}</label>

        @if (c.tipo === 'texto') {
        @if (c.soloLectura) {
        <input pInputText pSize="small" [id]="c.key" [formControlName]="c.key" readonly class="bg-gray-100" />
        } @else {
        <input pInputText [id]="c.key" [formControlName]="c.key" maxlength="120" [placeholder]="c.label"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid(c.key) }" />
        }
        } @else if (c.tipo === 'numero') {
        <p-inputnumber size="small" [formControlName]="c.key" [showButtons]="true"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid(c.key) }" />
        } @else if (c.tipo === 'select') {
        <div class="flex gap-2">
          @if (c.key === 'documentoId') {
          <p-select size="small" [formControlName]="c.key" [options]="opcionesDocumento()" optionLabel="label"
            optionValue="value" placeholder="Tipo documento..." styleClass="w-full" filter filterBy="label"
            [appendTo]="'body'" (ngModelChange)="onDocumentoIdChange()" />
          } @else if (c.key === 'nrodocumento') {
          <p-select size="small" [formControlName]="c.key" [options]="opcionesNroDocumento()" optionLabel="label"
            optionValue="value" placeholder="Nro. documento..." styleClass="w-full" filter filterBy="label"
            [appendTo]="'body'" />
          } @else {
          <p-select size="small" [formControlName]="c.key" [options]="opciones(c)" optionLabel="label"
            optionValue="value" placeholder="Seleccionar..." styleClass="w-full" [filter]="c.filtro ?? false"
            filterBy="label" [appendTo]="'body'" />
          }
          @if (c.selector) {
          <p-button type="button" icon="pi pi-search" severity="secondary" (onClick)="abrirSelector(c.selector)" />
          }
        </div>
        } @else if (c.tipo === 'fecha') {
        <p-datepicker [formControlName]="c.key" dateFormat="dd/mm/yy" styleClass="w-full" />
        }

        @if (invalid(c.key)) {
        <small class="err">{{ c.label }} es obligatorio</small>
        }
      </div>
      }
      }
    </div>

    @if (camposDet.length > 0) {
    <div class="card">
      <div class="detalles-head">
        <h2 class="detalles-title">Detalles</h2>
        <p-button type="button" label="Agregar fila" icon="pi pi-plus" variant="text" severity="success" size="small"
          [rounded]="true" (onClick)="nuevaFila()" />
      </div>

      <p-table [value]="dets()" [scrollable]="true" scrollHeight="400px" styleClass="det-table" [paginator]="true"
        [rows]="10" [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 25, 50]" [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
        currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}" size="small">
        <ng-template #header>
          <tr>
            @for (c of camposDet; track c.key) {
            @if (!c.oculto) {
            <th>{{ c.label }}</th>
            }
            }
            <th style="width: 80px"></th>
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
        <ng-template #body let-row let-idx="rowIndex">
          <tr>
            @for (c of camposDet; track c.key) {
            @if (!c.oculto) {
            <td>
              @if (c.tipo === 'numero') {
              <p-inputnumber size="small" [(ngModel)]="row[c.key]" [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }" />
              } @else if (c.tipo === 'fecha') {
              <p-datepicker [(ngModel)]="row[c.key]" [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }" dateFormat="dd/mm/yy"
                styleClass="w-full" />
              } @else if (c.tipo === 'select') {
              @if (c.key === 'formapagoId') {
              <p-select size="small" [ngModel]="row[c.key]"
                (ngModelChange)="row[c.key] = $event; onFormaPagoChange(row)" [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
                [options]="opciones(c)" optionLabel="label" optionValue="value" placeholder="Seleccionar..."
                styleClass="w-full" [filter]="c.filtro ?? false" filterBy="label" appendTo="body" />
              } @else {
              <p-select size="small" [ngModel]="row[c.key]" (ngModelChange)="row[c.key] = $event"
                [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }" [options]="opciones(c)" optionLabel="label" optionValue="value"
                placeholder="Seleccionar..." styleClass="w-full" [filter]="c.filtro ?? false" filterBy="label"
                appendTo="body" [disabled]="isCampoDesactivado(row, c.key)" />
              }
              } @else {
              <input pInputText pSize="small" [(ngModel)]="row[c.key]" [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
                [disabled]="isCampoDesactivado(row, c.key)"
                [placeholder]="isCampoDesactivado(row, c.key) ? '' : c.label" />
              }
            </td>
            }
            }
            <td>
              <p-button type="button" icon="pi pi-trash" severity="danger" variant="text" [rounded]="true" size="small"
                [disabled]="!esNuevaFila(row)" (onClick)="quitarFila(idx)" />
            </td>
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
        <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
          <tr>
            <td colspan="100" class="text-center p-3">Sin detalles. Agregue filas.</td>
          </tr>
        </ng-template>
      </p-table>
    </div>
    }

    <div class="acciones-form">
      <p-button type="button" label="Cancelar" icon="pi pi-times" variant="text" severity="secondary" size="small"
        [rounded]="true" (onClick)="volver()" />
      <p-button type="submit" label="Guardar" icon="pi pi-check" variant="text" severity="success" size="small"
        [rounded]="true" [loading]="guardando()" />
    </div>
  </form>
  }
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\maestro-detalle\maestro-detalle-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef } from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { DatePickerModule } from 'primeng/datepicker';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ApiService } from '../../../core/services/api.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { FacturacionService } from '../../../core/services/facturacion.service';
import { MAESTRO_DETALLE, MaestroDetalleConfig, CampoMae, CampoDetalle } from '../../../core/models/facturacion.models';
import { DialogService, DynamicDialogRef } from 'primeng/dynamicdialog';
import { EntitySelectorHelper, EntitySelectorConfig } from '../../helpers/entity-selector';
import { FooterHelper } from '../../helpers/footer';
import { CxcService } from '../../../core/services/cxc.service';
import { NavegacionService } from '../../../core/services/navegacion.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-maestro-detalle-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    InputNumberModule,
    SelectModule,
    DatePickerModule,
    TableModule,
  ],
  providers: [DialogService],
  templateUrl: './maestro-detalle-form.html',
  styleUrl: './maestro-detalle-form.scss',
})
export class MaestroDetalleForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  /** `protected` para subclases (ej. PagarPlanillaForm crea la cabecera
   *  antes de generar la planilla cuando se parte desde "nuevo"). */
  protected router = inject(Router);
  protected service = inject(FacturacionService);
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  protected auth = inject(AuthService);
  protected destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private dialogService = inject(DialogService);
  private cxcService = inject(CxcService);
  private navegacion = inject(NavegacionService);
  ref: DynamicDialogRef | undefined;
  protected msgs = inject(MessageService);

  config!: MaestroDetalleConfig;
  camposMae: CampoMae[] = [];
  camposDet: CampoDetalle[] = [];

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('');

  opcionesMap = signal<Record<string, { label: string; value: any }[]>>({});

  dets = signal<any[]>([]);
  detGuardados = new Set<number>();
  documentosPendientes = signal<any[]>([]);

  /**
   * Cabecera COMPLETA tal cual vino del backend en edición (incluye campos
   * que no son controles del form: flags de estado como `sn_autorizada` /
   * `sn_contabilizada` de planillas). Null en modo "nuevo".
   */
  maeActual = signal<any>(null);

  /** Id de la cabecera en edición (protegido para subclases como PagarPlanillaForm). */
  protected itemId = 0;
  private contadorFila = 0;
  private factorCambioDefault = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    const nombre = this.route.snapshot.data['nombre'] ?? '';
    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id') ?? '';

    this.config = MAESTRO_DETALLE[nombre];
    if (!this.config) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: `Módulo desconocido: ${nombre}` });
      return;
    }
    this.camposMae = this.config.camposMae;
    this.camposDet = this.config.camposDet;
    this.titulo.set(this.config.titulo);
    this.buildForm();
    this.cargarOpciones();
    this.vigilarCliente();
    this.cargarFactorCambio();

    if (id && id !== 'nuevo') {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.itemId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getMaeOne<any>(this.config.rutaMae, this.itemId).subscribe({
        next: (mae) => {
          const patch: Record<string, any> = {};
          for (const c of this.camposMae) {
            const v = mae?.[c.key];
            patch[c.key] = c.tipo === 'fecha' && v ? new Date(v) : v;
          }
          this.form.patchValue(patch);
          this.maeActual.set(mae);
          this.cargarDets();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Registro no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private buildForm() {
    const group: Record<string, any> = {};
    for (const c of this.camposMae) {
      const hasDefault = c.defaultValue !== undefined && c.defaultValue !== null;
      const initial = hasDefault ? c.defaultValue : (c.tipo === 'numero' ? 0 : null);
      group[c.key] = [initial, c.requerido ? Validators.required : []];
    }
    this.form = this.fb.group(group);
  }

  private cargarOpciones() {
    const all = [...this.camposMae, ...this.camposDet] as (CampoMae | CampoDetalle)[];
    for (const c of all) {
      if (c.cargaOpciones) {
        this.api.get<any>(c.cargaOpciones.url).subscribe({
          next: (res) => {
            let items: any[] = [];
            if (Array.isArray(res)) {
              items = res;
            } else if (res && typeof res === 'object') {
              const candidate = res.data ?? res.results ?? Object.values(res).find(Array.isArray) ?? [];
              items = Array.isArray(candidate) ? candidate : [];
            }
            let filtered = items;
            const filtro = (c as CampoMae).filtroAbreviaturas;
            if (filtro?.length) {
              filtered = filtered.filter((i: any) => filtro.includes(i.abreviatura));
            }
            const opts = filtered.map((i: any) => ({
              label: String(i[c.cargaOpciones!.labelCampo] ?? i[c.cargaOpciones!.valueCampo] ?? ''),
              value: i[c.cargaOpciones!.valueCampo],
            }));
            this.opcionesMap.update((m) => ({ ...m, [c.key]: opts }));
          },
        });
      }
    }
  }

  opciones(c: CampoMae | CampoDetalle): { label: string; value: any }[] {
    if (c.cargaOpciones) return this.opcionesMap()[c.key] ?? [];
    return (c as any).opciones ?? [];
  }

  esEfectivo(row: any): boolean {
    const opts = this.opcionesMap()['formapagoId'] ?? [];
    const selected = opts.find((o: any) => o.value === row['formapagoId']);
    return selected ? /efectivo/i.test(selected.label) : false;
  }

  onFormaPagoChange(row: any) {
    if (this.esEfectivo(row)) {
      row['tarjetacreditoId'] = null;
      row['nrotarjeta'] = '';
      row['nroautorizacion'] = '';
    }
  }

  isCampoDesactivado(row: any, key: string): boolean {
    const camposTarjeta = ['tarjetacreditoId', 'nrotarjeta', 'nroautorizacion'];
    return camposTarjeta.includes(key) && this.esEfectivo(row);
  }

  abrirSelector(selectorName: string) {
    (this as any)[selectorName]?.();
  }

  private vigilarCliente() {
    this.form.get('clienteId')?.valueChanges.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe((clienteId) => {
      if (!clienteId) {
        this.form.patchValue({ nrocliente: '', nombrecliente: '' });
        this.documentosPendientes.set([]);
        this.filtrarOpcionesDocumento();
        return;
      }
      this.api.get<any>(`/cxc/clientes/${clienteId}`).subscribe({
        next: (cliente) => this.form.patchValue({
          nrocliente: cliente?.nrocliente ?? '',
          nombrecliente: `${cliente?.nombres ?? ''} ${cliente?.apellidos ?? ''}`.trim(),
        }),
        error: () => this.form.patchValue({ nrocliente: '', nombrecliente: '' }),
      });
      this.cxcService.getDocumentosPendientesCliente(clienteId).subscribe({
        next: (docs) => {
          this.documentosPendientes.set(docs);
          this.filtrarOpcionesDocumento();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.documentosPendientes.set([]);
          this.filtrarOpcionesDocumento();
        },
      });
    });
  }

  private filtrarOpcionesDocumento() {
    const docs = this.documentosPendientes();
    const tiposUnicos = [...new Set(docs.map(d => d.documentoId))];
    const allOpts = this.opcionesMap()['documentoId'] ?? [];
    const filtradas = allOpts.filter(o => tiposUnicos.includes(o.value));
    this.opcionesMap.update(m => ({ ...m, ['__docFiltradas']: filtradas }));
    this.form.get('documentoId')?.setValue(null);
    this.form.get('nrodocumento')?.setValue(null);
    this.opcionesMap.update(m => ({ ...m, ['__nroDocFiltradas']: [] }));
  }

  opcionesDocumento(): { label: string; value: any }[] {
    return this.opcionesMap()['__docFiltradas'] ?? this.opcionesMap()['documentoId'] ?? [];
  }

  opcionesNroDocumento(): { label: string; value: any }[] {
    const docId = this.form.get('documentoId')?.value;
    if (!docId) return [];
    const docs = this.documentosPendientes().filter(d => d.documentoId === docId);
    return docs.map(d => ({
      label: `${d.nroreferencia} (Saldo: ${d.saldo.toFixed(2)})`,
      value: d.nroreferencia,
    }));
  }

  onDocumentoIdChange() {
    const docId = this.form.get('documentoId')?.value;
    this.form.get('nrodocumento')?.setValue(null);
    if (docId) {
      const docs = this.documentosPendientes().filter(d => d.documentoId === docId);
      const opts = docs.map(d => ({
        label: `${d.nroreferencia} (Saldo: ${d.saldo.toFixed(2)})`,
        value: d.nroreferencia,
      }));
      this.opcionesMap.update(m => ({ ...m, ['__nroDocFiltradas']: opts }));
    } else {
      this.opcionesMap.update(m => ({ ...m, ['__nroDocFiltradas']: [] }));
    }
  }

  abrirClientes() {
    const config: EntitySelectorConfig = {
      titulo: 'Seleccionar cliente con saldo',
      columns: [
        { key: 'nrocliente', label: 'Nro.' },
        { key: 'cliente', label: 'Nombre' },
        { key: 'dni', label: 'DNI' },
        { key: 'rtn', label: 'RTN' },
      ],
      loadData: () => {
        return new Promise<any[]>((resolve) => {
          this.api.get<any>('/cxc/clientes-con-saldo').subscribe({
            next: (res) => {
              const items = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res?.data ?? []);
              resolve(items);
            },
            error: () => resolve([]),
          });
        });
      },
    };

    this.ref = this.dialogService.open(EntitySelectorHelper, {
      header: config.titulo,
      width: '60vw',
      modal: true,
      contentStyle: { overflow: 'auto' },
      data: { config },
      templates: { footer: FooterHelper },
    });

    this.ref.onClose.subscribe((cliente: any) => {
      if (cliente) {
        this.form.patchValue({
          clienteId: cliente.clienteId,
          nrocliente: cliente.nrocliente ?? '',
          nombrecliente: `${cliente.nombres ?? ''} ${cliente.apellidos ?? ''}`.trim(),
        });
      }
    });
  }

  private cargarFactorCambio() {
    this.api.get<any[]>('/contabilidad/factordecambio').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (items) => {
        const dolares = (items ?? [])
          .filter((f) => f.tipomoneda === 'D')
          .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.fecharegistro).getTime() - new Date(a.fecharegistro).getTime());
        if (dolares.length > 0) {
          this.factorCambioDefault = Number(dolares[0].preciocompra) || 0;
        }
      },
    });
  }

  private cargarDets() {
    // Sólo hay endpoint "por id" si la config lo declara (`rutaDetById`:
    // facturas, cotizaciones, pedidos). Sin esa ruta se cargan todas las
    // filas del recurso y se filtran por la FK; antes se adivinaba
    // `rutaDet/factura/:id` y generaba un 404 ruidoso en la consola.
    if (!this.config.rutaDetById) {
      this.cargarDetsFiltrando();
      return;
    }

    this.service.getDet<any>(`${this.config.rutaDetById}/${this.itemId}`).subscribe({
      next: (mios) => this.asignarDets(mios ?? []),
      error: () => this.cargarDetsFiltrando(),
    });
  }

  /** Carga todos los detalles del recurso y conserva sólo los de esta cabecera. */
  protected cargarDetsFiltrando() {
    this.service.getDet<any>(this.config.rutaDet).subscribe({
      next: (todos) =>
        this.asignarDets((todos ?? []).filter((d) => d[this.config.fkDet] === this.itemId)),
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los detalles' });
      },
    });
  }

  private asignarDets(mios: any[]) {
    this.dets.set(mios.map((d) => ({ ...d })));
    for (const d of mios) this.detGuardados.add(d[this.config.idKeyDet]);
    this.contadorFila = mios.length;
    this.cargando.set(false);
  }

  nuevaFila() {
    this.contadorFila += 1;
    const fila: any = { __local: true };
    for (const c of this.camposDet) {
      if (c.key === 'nrofila') fila[c.key] = this.contadorFila;
      else if (c.key === 'factordecambio') fila[c.key] = this.factorCambioDefault;
      else fila[c.key] = c.tipo === 'numero' || c.tipo === 'moneda' ? 0 : c.tipo === 'fecha' ? new Date() : '';
    }
    this.dets.update((d) => [...d, fila]);
  }

  quitarFila(idx: number) {
    const fila = this.dets()[idx];
    if (fila[this.config.idKeyDet] && this.detGuardados.has(fila[this.config.idKeyDet])) return;
    this.dets.update((d) => d.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.navegacion.volver([this.config.rutaMae]);
  }

  esNuevaFila(fila: any): boolean {
    return !fila[this.config.idKeyDet] || !this.detGuardados.has(fila[this.config.idKeyDet]);
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const maeBody = {
      ...this.form.getRawValue(),
      ...(this.esEdicion() ? {} : { empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId }),
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const maeOp = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.updateMae<any>(this.config.rutaMae, this.itemId, maeBody as any)
      : this.service.createMae<any>(this.config.rutaMae, maeBody as any);

    maeOp.subscribe({
      next: (mae) => {
        const maeId = this.esEdicion() ? this.itemId : mae[this.config.idKeyMae];
        this.guardarDets(maeId);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo guardar el documento' });
      },
    });
  }

  private guardarDets(maeId: number) {
    const pendientes = this.dets().length;
    if (pendientes === 0) {
      this.finalizar();
      return;
    }

    let completados = 0;
    const ok = () => {
      completados += 1;
      if (completados === pendientes) this.finalizar();
    };
    const fail = () => {
      this.guardando.set(false);
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo guardar uno de los detalles' });
    };

    const empresaId = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;
    for (const fila of this.dets()) {
      const detId = fila[this.config.idKeyDet];
      const body = { ...fila, [this.config.fkDet]: maeId, empresaId };
      delete body.__local;
      if (detId && this.detGuardados.has(detId)) {
        this.service.updateDet<any>(this.config.rutaDet, detId, body as any).subscribe({ next: ok, error: fail });
      } else {
        this.service.createDet<any>(this.config.rutaDet, body as any).subscribe({ next: ok, error: fail });
      }
    }
  }

  private finalizar() {
    this.guardando.set(false);
    this.msgs.add({
      severity: 'success',
      summary: 'Guardado',
      detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Documento actualizado' : 'Documento creado correctamente',
    });
    this.form.reset();
    for (const c of this.camposMae) {
      const hasDefault = c.defaultValue !== undefined && c.defaultValue !== null;
      const initial = hasDefault ? c.defaultValue : (c.tipo === 'numero' ? 0 : null);
      this.form.get(c.key)?.setValue(initial);
    }
    this.dets.set([]);
    this.detGuardados.clear();
    this.contadorFila = 0;
    this.documentosPendientes.set([]);
    this.esEdicion.set(false);
    this.itemId = 0;
    this.filtrarOpcionesDocumento();
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\facturacion\maestro-detalle\maestro-detalle.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, computed, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { FacturacionService } from '../../../core/services/facturacion.service';
import { MAESTRO_DETALLE, MaestroDetalleConfig } from '../../../core/models/facturacion.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-maestro-detalle',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule],
  templateUrl: './maestro-detalle.html',
  styleUrl: './maestro-detalle.scss',
})
export class MaestroDetalle implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(FacturacionService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  config!: MaestroDetalleConfig;

  data = signal<any[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<any[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  /** Encabezados de la tabla: el título del registro + las etiquetas de `filasLista`. */
  columnasLista = computed<string[]>(() => {
    const primero = this.filtered()[0] ?? this.data()[0];
    if (!this.config || !primero) return [];
    return this.config.filasLista(primero).map((f) => f.label);
  });

  ngOnInit() {
    const nombre = this.route.snapshot.data['nombre'] ?? '';
    this.config = MAESTRO_DETALLE[nombre];
    if (!this.config) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: `Módulo desconocido: ${nombre}` });
      return;
    }
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getMae<any>(this.config.rutaMae).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: `No se pudieron cargar ${this.config.titulo}` });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((i) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return JSON.stringify(i).toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    if (this.config.soloLectura) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', 'nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id: number) {
    if (this.config.soloLectura) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }
}
```

```typescript
        <div>

              <input

                placeholder="RTN del cliente"
                class="w-full"
              />
            </div>

            <div class="field">
              <label for="gestorId">Gestor de ventas</label>
              <p-select
                size="small"
                id="gestorId"
                formControlName="gestorId"
                [options]="gestores()"
                optionLabel="label"
                optionValue="value"
                filter
                showClear
                placeholder="Seleccionar gestor..."
                styleClass="w-full"
                [appendTo]="'body'"
              />
            </div>

            <div class="field">
              <label>Descuento</label>
              <p-select
                size="small"
                [options]="descuentos()"
                optionLabel="label"
                optionValue="value"
                placeholder="Sin descuento"
                [showClear]="true"
                style="width: 100%"
                [appendTo]="'body'"
                [ngModel]="descuentoGlobalId()"
                [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
                (ngModelChange)="descuentoGlobalId.set($event); onDescuentoGlobalChange()"
              />
            </div>

            <div class="field">
              <div class="campo campo-inline">
                <label>Exenta de ISV</label>
                <p-selectbutton
                  size="small"
                  [options]="snOptions"
                  formControlName="sn_excenta"
                  optionLabel="label"
                  optionValue="value"
                  (onChange)="recalcularExenta()"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="field">
              <div class="campo ml-campo">
                <label for="tipoconstancia">Tipo Constancia</label>
                <p-select
                  id="tipoconstancia"
                  formControlName="tipoconstancia"
                  [options]="tipoConstanciaOpciones"
                  optionLabel="label"
                  optionValue="value"
                  placeholder="Seleccionar..."
                  size="small"
                  styleClass="w-full"
                  [appendTo]="'body'"
                  [disabled]="form.get('sn_excenta')?.value !== 'S'"
                />
                @if (form.get('sn_excenta')?.value === 'S' && invalid('tipoconstancia')) {
                <small class="err">Seleccione el tipo de constancia</small>
                }
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="field">
              <div class="campo ml-campo">
                <label for="nroconstancia">Nro. Constancia</label>
                <input
                  pInputText
                  id="nroconstancia"
                  formControlName="nroconstancia"
                  pSize="small"
                  placeholder="Constancia"
                  [attr.readonly]="form.get('sn_excenta')?.value !== 'S' || null"
                  [class.p-inputtext-disabled]="form.get('sn_excenta')?.value !== 'S'"
                />
                @if (form.get('sn_excenta')?.value === 'S' && invalid('nroconstancia')) {
                <small class="err">Ingrese el número de constancia</small>
                }
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="field">
              <div class="campo ml-campo">
                <label for="importe_excento">Importe Excento</label>
                <p-inputNumber
                  id="importe_excento"
                  formControlName="importe_excento"
                  mode="currency"
                  currency="HNL"
                  [locale]="'es-HN'"
                  [minFractionDigits]="2"
                  [maxFractionDigits]="2"
                  [useGrouping]="true"
                  size="small"
                  styleClass="w-full"
                  [inputStyle]="{ width: '100%' }"
                  [readonly]="true"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="field">
              <p-button
                type="button"
                label="Salir"
                variant="text"
                severity="secondary"
                icon="pi pi-sign-out"
                size="small"
                [rounded]="true"
                (onClick)="salir()"
              />

              <p-button
                type="button"
                label="Nueva"
                icon="pi pi-file"
                variant="text"
                severity="success"
                size="small"
                [rounded]="true"
                (onClick)="nueva()"
                pTooltip="ESC Cancelar"
              />
              @if (form.get('tipofactura')?.value === 'C') {
              <p-button
                type="button"
                label="Facturar"
                icon="pi pi-check-circle"
                size="small"
                [rounded]="true"
                variant="text"
                severity="success"
                [loading]="guardando()"
                (onClick)="facturar()"
                pTooltip="ALT + 8 Finalizar"
              />
              } @else {
              <p-button
                type="button"
                label="Pagar"
                variant="text"
                severity="info"
                icon="pi pi-credit-card"
                size="small"
                [rounded]="true"
                (onClick)="abrirPagos()"
                [badge]="pagosConImporte().length > 0 ? pagosConImporte().length + '' : undefined"
                pTooltip="ALT + 6 Pago"
              />
              }
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <span class="alt9">Presione Alt+9 para ver ventana de atajos</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
</section>

<p-dialog
  header="Formas de Pago"
  [(visible)]="dialogPagos"
  [modal]="true"
  [style]="{ width: '80vw', height: '85vh' }"
  [contentStyle]="{ overflow: 'auto' }"
  [draggable]="false"
  [resizable]="false"
  [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }"
>
  <div class="pago-dialog-body">
    <div class="pago-add-row">
      <p-button
        size="small"
        label="Agregar pago"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        severity="success"
        variant="text"
        [raised]="true"
        [rounded]="true"
        (onClick)="agregarPago()"
      />
    </div>
    <p-table
      [value]="pagos()"
      size="small"
      [scrollable]="true"
      scrollHeight="flex"
      [tableStyle]="{ 'min-width': '100%' }"
    >
      <ng-template #header>
        <tr>
          <th style="color: var(--color-texto-label); width: 25%">Forma de Pago</th>
          <th style="color: var(--color-texto-label); width: 20%">Tarjeta</th>
          <th style="color: var(--color-texto-label); width: 15%">Nro. Tarjeta</th>
          <th style="color: var(--color-texto-label); width: 15%">Autorización</th>
          <th style="color: var(--color-texto-label); width: 10%">Importe</th>
          <th style="color: var(--color-texto-label); width: 5%"></th>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template #body let-pago let-idx="rowIndex">
        <tr>
          <td>
            <p-select
              size="small"
              [options]="formaspago()"
              optionLabel="label"
              optionValue="value"
              placeholder="Seleccionar..."
              styleClass="w-full"
              [(ngModel)]="pago.formapagoId"
              [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
              [appendTo]="'body'"
              (onChange)="onFormaPagoChange(pago)"
            />
          </td>
          <td>
            @if (esTarjeta(pago)) {
            <p-select
              size="small"
              [options]="tarjetas()"
              optionLabel="label"
              optionValue="value"
              placeholder="Seleccionar..."
              styleClass="w-full"
              showClear
              [(ngModel)]="pago.tarjetacreditoId"
              [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
              [appendTo]="'body'"
            />
            }
          </td>
          <td>
            @if (esTarjeta(pago)) {
            <input
              pInputText
              pSize="small"
              [(ngModel)]="pago.nrotarjeta"
              [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
              placeholder="Nro. tarjeta"
              class="w-full"
            />
            }
          </td>
          <td>
            @if (esTarjeta(pago) || esTransferencia(pago)) {
            <input
              pInputText
              pSize="small"
              [(ngModel)]="pago.nroautorizacion"
              [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
              placeholder="Autorización"
              class="w-full"
            />
            }
          </td>
          <td>
            <p-inputnumber
              size="small"
              [(ngModel)]="pago.importe"
              [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
              [min]="0"
              mode="currency"
              currency="HNL"
              [locale]="'es-HN'"
              [minFractionDigits]="2"
              [maxFractionDigits]="2"
              [useGrouping]="true"
              [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }"
              styleClass="w-full"
            />
          </td>
          <td class="text-center">
            <p-button
              icon="pi pi-times"
              [rounded]="true"
              severity="danger"
              size="small"
              (onClick)="quitarPago(idx)"
            />
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
        <tr>
          <td colspan="7" class="text-center p-3">
            Sin formas de pago. Presione "Agregar pago" para comenzar.
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
    </p-table>
  </div>
  <ng-template pTemplate="footer">
    <div class="grid w-full">
      <div class="col-12 md:col-6 lg:col-3">
        <span>Total Factura:</span>
        <span class="font-bold"> {{ moneda(totales().total) }}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="col-12 md:col-6 lg:col-3">
        <span>Total Pagos:</span>
        <span
          class="font-bold"
          [class.text-ok]="totalPagos() >= totales().total"
          [class.text-warn]="totalPagos() < totales().total && totalPagos() > 0"
        >
          {{ moneda(totalPagos()) }}</span
        >
      </div>
      <div class="col-12 md:col-6 lg:col-3">
        @if (pendiente() > 0) {
        <span> Pendiente:</span>
        <span class="font-bold text-warn"> {{ moneda(pendiente()) }}</span>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="col-12 md:col-6 lg:col-3">
        @if (cambioTotal() > 0) {
        <span>Cambio:</span>
        <span class="font-bold cambio-amount">{{ moneda(cambioTotal()) }}</span>
        }
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="pago-dialog-actions">
      <p-button
        type="button"
        label="Cancelar"
        icon="pi pi-times"
        variant="text"
        severity="secondary"
        size="small"
        [rounded]="true"
        (onClick)="dialogPagos.set(false)"
      />
      <p-button
        type="button"
        label="Facturar"
        icon="pi pi-shopping-cart"
        [loading]="guardando()"
        size="small"
        severity="success"
        variant="text"
        [rounded]="true"
        (onClick)="facturar()"
      />
    </div>
  </ng-template>
</p-dialog>

<p-dialog
  header="Ventas Suspendidas (ALT + 4)"
  [(visible)]="dialogSuspendidas"
  [modal]="true"
  [style]="{ width: '70vw' }"
  [draggable]="false"
  [resizable]="false"
  [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }"
>
  <p-table
    [value]="ventasSuspendidas()"
    size="small"
    [scrollable]="true"
    scrollHeight="400px"
    styleClass="det-table"
    [paginator]="true"
    [rows]="10"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 25, 50]"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
    currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
  >
    <ng-template #header>
      <tr>
        <th style="width: 10rem">Fecha</th>
        <th>Cliente</th>
        <th>Artículos</th>
        <th style="width: 10rem" class="text-right">Total</th>
        <th style="width: 8rem"></th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template #body let-v let-idx="rowIndex">
      <tr>
        <td>{{ v.fecha | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
        <td>{{ v.nombreClienteManual || v.nrocliente || 'N/A' }}</td>
        <td>{{ v.filas?.length ?? 0 }}</td>
        <td class="text-right">{{ moneda(v.totales?.total) }}</td>
        <td class="text-center">
          <p-button
            icon="pi pi-upload"
            [rounded]="true"
            severity="success"
            size="small"
            pTooltip="Restaurar"
            (onClick)="restaurarVenta(v)"
          />
          <p-button
            icon="pi pi-trash"
            [rounded]="true"
            severity="danger"
            size="small"
            pTooltip="Eliminar"
            (onClick)="eliminarVentaSuspendida(v)"
          />
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr>
        <td colspan="5" class="text-center p-3">No hay ventas suspendidas</td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>
</p-dialog>

<p-dialog
  header="Atajos de Teclado (ALT + 9)"
  [(visible)]="dialogAtajos"
  [modal]="true"
  [style]="{ width: '420px' }"
  [draggable]="false"
  [resizable]="false"
  [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }"
>
  <div class="atajos-list">
    @for (a of atajos; track a.tecla) {
    <div class="atajo-row">
      <kbd>{{ a.tecla }}</kbd>
      <span>{{ a.accion }}</span>
    </div>
    }
  </div>
</p-dialog>

<!-- Diálogo headless TodoPago: notificación llamativa del link (y del pago confirmado) -->
<p-confirmdialog
  key="tp-link"
  styleClass="tp-hl-dialog"
  [modal]="true"
  [style]="{ width: '460px' }"
  [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }"
  [dismissableMask]="true"
>
  <ng-template #headless let-message let-onAccept="onAccept" let-onReject="onReject">
    @if (linkPago(); as link) {
    <div class="tp-hl">
      @if (linkStatus() === 'completed') {
      <!-- Variante: pago confirmado -->
      <div class="tp-hl-badge tp-hl-badge--ok">
        <i class="pi pi-check"></i>
      </div>
      <span class="tp-hl-title">¡Pago confirmado!</span>
      <p class="tp-hl-sub">Factura #{{ nroFacturaLink() }} — el cobro se recibió vía TodoPago</p>
      <div class="tp-hl-monto tp-hl-monto--ok">{{ moneda(link.monto) }}</div>
      <div class="tp-hl-status">
        <p-tag [value]="labelEstadoLink()" [severity]="severityEstadoLink()" />
      </div>
      <div class="tp-hl-actions">
        <p-button
          size="small"
          label="Entendido"
          icon="pi pi-check"
          severity="success"
          [raised]="true"
          [rounded]="true"
          (onClick)="onAccept()"
        />
      </div>
      } @else {
      <!-- Variante: link generado (pendiente) -->
      <div class="tp-hl-badge">
        <i class="pi pi-link"></i>
      </div>
      <span class="tp-hl-title">Link de pago generado</span>
      <p class="tp-hl-sub">Factura #{{ nroFacturaLink() }} — comparta el link con el cliente</p>
      <div class="tp-hl-monto">
        {{ moneda(link.monto) }} @if (link.sandbox) {
        <span class="tp-hl-sandbox">SANDBOX</span>
        }
      </div>
      <div class="tp-hl-status">
        <p-tag [value]="labelEstadoLink()" [severity]="severityEstadoLink()" />
      </div>
      <input
        pInputText
        pSize="small"
        class="w-full tp-hl-url"
        [ngModel]="link.url"
        [ngModelOptions]="{ standalone: true }"
        readonly
      />
      <div class="tp-hl-actions">
        <p-button
          size="small"
          [label]="linkCopiado() ? 'Copiado' : 'Copiar link'"
          icon="pi pi-copy"
          severity="success"
          [raised]="true"
          [rounded]="true"
          (onClick)="copiarLink()"
        />
        <p-button
          size="small"
          label="Abrir link"
          icon="pi pi-external-link"
          severity="info"
          variant="text"
          [rounded]="true"
          (onClick)="abrirLink()"
        />
        <p-button
          size="small"
          label="Estado"
          icon="pi pi-refresh"
          severity="secondary"
          variant="text"
          [rounded]="true"
          (onClick)="consultarEstadoLink()"
        />
        <p-button
          size="small"
          label="Cerrar"
          icon="pi pi-times"
          severity="secondary"
          variant="text"
          [rounded]="true"
          (onClick)="onReject()"
        />
      </div>
      }
    </div>
    }
  </ng-template>
</p-confirmdialog>

```

```typescript
.field {

}

.col-5 {

}

}

}

}

}

.nf-col-right {

  min-width: 0;
}

    flex: 1;

}

// Label a la izquierda + control a la derecha en UNA sola fila
// (ahorra altura vertical en el panel derecho — evita scroll innecesario)
.campo-inline {

    white-space: nowrap;

// Panel derecho: en desktop sube -40px respecto a la tabla (ajuste visual del usuario).
// En tablet/móvil la columna apila debajo de la tabla → el margen negativo
// la haría solaparse, por eso se anula por debajo del breakpoint xl (1200px).
.nf-panel-col {

.nf-totales {

.nf-total-block {

.nf-actions {

.productos-busqueda {

.row-selectable {

}

.cell-producto {

    font-weight: 700;

// ARFM20261030 Imagen de producto con efecto retroiluminado (mismo que pedido-form):
// la luz va de ATRÁS hacia DELANTE (halo detrás del círculo), la imagen conserva
// su propio color de fondo, forma casi redonda y bordes suavizados (máscara radial).
.img-backlight {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 50px;
  height: 50px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-border) 45%, transparent),
    0 0 8px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-border) 55%, transparent),
    0 0 18px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-border) 32%, transparent),
    0 0 30px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-border) 16%, transparent);
}

.img-clickable {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.img-producto {
  background: transparent;
  object-fit: contain;
  width: 50px;
  height: 50px;
  border-radius: 46%;
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 78%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 78%, transparent 100%);
    box-shadow: none;
}

.campo-full {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ARFM20261030 Popover de existencia — card estilo menú de restaurante
// (idéntico a pedido-form.scss; reemplaza al hover-zoom .img-zoom-overlay)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.icono-sin-imagen {
  color: slateblue;
}

// Panel del popover: sin padding del PrimeNG, bordes redondeados, sombra propia
::ng-deep .p-popover {
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border-strong);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);

  .p-popover-content {
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
}

.menu-card {
  width: 19rem;
  background: var(--c-card-background);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

// Media: imagen grande centrada con halo radial de --c-primary detrás
.menu-card-media {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 14rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  // recorta el zoom para que no se desborde del media
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-primary) 12%, transparent),
      transparent 70%);
}

// Tag de estado superpuesto en la esquina del media — SIEMPRE por encima del zoom
.menu-card-tag {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.5rem;
  right: 0.5rem;
  z-index: 2;
}

.img-producto-lg {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  background: transparent;
  object-fit: contain;
  width: 170px;
    height: 170px;
    border-radius: 46%;
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 78%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 78%, transparent 100%);
    box-shadow: none;
    // zoom suave al pasar el mouse (la tag queda por encima por z-index)
    transition: transform 0.25s ease;
  
    .menu-card-media:hover & {
      transform: scale(1.35);
    }
  }
  
  // Ficha inferior: código, descripción, precio + chip de existencia
  .menu-card-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem 0.9rem;
  }
  
  .menu-card-cod {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--c-text-muted);
  }
  
  .menu-card-desc {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.25;
    color: #fff;
  }
  
  .menu-card-meta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-top: 0.35rem;
  }
  
  .menu-card-precio {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--c-primary);
  }
  
  // Chip de existencia (en lugar del botón "Buy" del ejemplo PrimeNG)
  .menu-card-stock {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.55rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
  
    i {
      font-size: 0.75rem;

    // Niveles según row.estado (ALTA / BAJO / AGOTADO / SIN_STOCK)
    &.nivel-alta {

      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-success) 14%, transparent);
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-success) 45%, transparent);
    }
  
    &.nivel-bajo {
      color: var(--c-warning);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-warning) 14%, transparent);
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-warning) 45%, transparent);
    }
  
    &.nivel-agotado {
      color: var(--c-danger);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-danger) 14%, transparent);
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-danger) 45%, transparent);
    }
  
    &.nivel-sin_stock {
      color: var(--c-info);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-info) 14%, transparent);
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-info) 45%, transparent);
    }
}

.tp-hl {

  .tp-hl-actions {

}

// En modo headless el footer de ConfirmDialog queda vacío (o con botones por defecto

}
// ARFM20261030 MEJORA consumida aquí: alturas de las filas en blanco del footer

.empty-row td {
  height: 45px;
}
```

```typescript
export class NuevaFactura implements OnInit {

    this.api
```
