```typescript
      [value]="productosFiltrados()"
      responsiveLayout="scroll"
       [filterDelay]="200"
      [rows]="5"
      [paginator]="true"
    >
      <ng-template pTemplate="header">
        <tr>
          <th style="width: 6rem">Imagen</th>
          <th pSortableColumn="descripcion">
            <div class="flex align-items-center gap-2">
              Descripción
              <p-sortIcon field="descripcion"></p-sortIcon>
            </div>
          </th>
          <th pSortableColumn="codbarra">
            <div class="flex align-items-center gap-2">
              Código
              <p-sortIcon field="codbarra"></p-sortIcon>
            </div>
          </th>
          <th pSortableColumn="precioventa" style="width: 12rem" class="text-right">
            <div class="flex align-items-center justify-content-end gap-2">
              Precio Venta
              <p-sortIcon field="precioventa"></p-sortIcon>
            </div>
          </th>
          <th style="width: 4em"></th>
        </tr>
        <tr class="filtros-row">
          <th></th>
          <th>
            <input
              pInputText
              type="text"
              [ngModel]="filtroDescripcion()"
              (ngModelChange)="filtroDescripcion.set($event)"
              placeholder="Filtrar descripción"
              class="w-full"
            />
          </th>
          <th>
            <input
              pInputText
              type="text"
              [ngModel]="filtroCodbarra()"
              (ngModelChange)="filtroCodbarra.set($event)"
              placeholder="Filtrar código"
              class="w-full"
            />
          </th>
          <th></th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>

      <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-product>
        <tr (click)="selectProduct(product)" class="row-selectable">
          <td class="img-cell">
            @if (imagenDe(product)) {
              <img [src]="imagenDe(product)" [alt]="product.descripcion" loading="lazy" />
            } @else {
              <span class="img-placeholder"><i class="pi pi-image"></i></span>
            }
          </td>
          <td>{{ product.descripcion }}</td>
          <td>{{ product.codbarra }}</td>
          <td class="text-right">{{ product.precioventa }}</td>
          <td>
            <p-button
              type="button"
              [text]="true"
              [rounded]="true"
              severity="success"
              icon="pi pi-chevron-circle-right"
              (click)="selectProduct(product); $event.stopPropagation()"
            />
          </td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
      <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
        <tr>
          <td colspan="5" class="text-center p-3">Sin resultados</td>
        </tr>
      </ng-template>
    </p-table>
  `,
})
export class ProductosHelperList implements OnInit {
  products = signal<Producto[]>([]);

  /** Map productoId → imagen dataURL (de /inventario/productos-img).
   *  Debe ser signal para que la tabla redibuje al llegar (ARFM20261030). */
  private imagenesMap = signal<Map<number, string>>(new Map());

  filtroCodbarra = signal('');
  filtroDescripcion = signal('');

  productosFiltrados = computed(() => {
    const cod = this.filtroCodbarra().toLowerCase().trim();
    const desc = this.filtroDescripcion().toLowerCase().trim();
    return this.products().filter(
      (p) =>
        (!cod || (p.codbarra ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(cod)) &&
        (!desc || (p.descripcion ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(desc)),
    );
  });

  constructor(
    private productService: ProductosService,
    private dialogService: DialogService,
    private ref: DynamicDialogRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit() {
    this.productService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (products: Producto[]) => {
        this.products.set(products);
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error al cargar productos', error);
      },
    });

    // Imágenes de productos (ARFM20261030): solo activas, 1ª por producto
    this.productService.getImgAll().subscribe({
      next: (items: ProductoImg[]) => {
        const m = new Map<number, string>(this.imagenesMap());
        for (const i of items ?? []) {
          const id = Number(i.productoId);
          if (i.sn_activo === 'S' && i.img && !m.has(id)) {
            m.set(id, this.resolverImagen(i.img));
          }
        }
        this.imagenesMap.set(m);
      },
      error: (error) => {
        console.error('Error al cargar imágenes de productos', error);
      },
    });
  }

  /** Imagen del producto para la tabla (dataURL) o '' si no tiene */
  imagenDe(product: Producto): string {
    return this.imagenesMap().get(Number(product.produtoId)) ?? '';
  }

  private resolverImagen(img: string): string {
    return /^data:/i.test(img) ? img : `data:image/png;base64,${img}`;
  }

  selectProduct(product: Producto) {
    this.ref.close(product);
  }

  showInfo() {
    this.dialogService.open(InfoHelper, {
      header: 'Información',
      modal: true,
      dismissableMask: true,
      data: {
        totalItems: this.products().length,
      },
    });
  }

  closeDialog(data) {
    this.ref.close(data);
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\ajustes\ajustes.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef, ChangeDetectionStrategy } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { ToastModule } from 'primeng/toast';
import { ConfirmDialogModule } from 'primeng/confirmdialog';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { DialogService, DynamicDialogRef } from 'primeng/dynamicdialog';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { AjusteInventarioService } from '../../../core/services/ajuste-inventario.service';
import { BodegasService } from '../../../core/services/bodegas.service';
import { ProductosService } from '../../../core/services/productos.service';
import { Bodega, Producto } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';
import { ProductosHelperList } from '../../helpers/productos';
import { FooterHelper } from '../../helpers/footer';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-ajustes',
  standalone: true,
  providers: [DialogService],
  imports: [
    CommonModule, FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule,
    TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, InputNumberModule,
    SelectModule, TagModule, ToastModule, ConfirmDialogModule, TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './ajustes.html',
  styleUrl: './ajustes.scss',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class Ajustes implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private service = inject(AjusteInventarioService);
  private bodegasService = inject(BodegasService);
  private productosService = inject(ProductosService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private dialogService = inject(DialogService);

  ref: DynamicDialogRef | undefined;

  ajustes = signal<any[]>([]);
  detalles = signal<any[]>([]);
  bodegas = signal<Bodega[]>([]);
  productos = signal<Producto[]>([]);

  seleccionado = signal<any | null>(null);
  cargando = signal(false);
  cargandoDet = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);

  codBusqueda = signal('');

  formMae = this.fb.group({
    concepto: ['', Validators.required],
    bodegaId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    sn_entrada: ['S' as 'S' | 'N', Validators.required],
  });

  formDet = this.fb.group({
    codbarra: ['', Validators.required],
    productoId: [null as number | null],
    descripcion: [''],
    cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
  });

  ngOnInit() {
    this.cargarAjustes();
    this.cargarBodegas();
    this.cargarProductos();
  }

  cargarAjustes() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => { this.ajustes.set(data || []); this.cargando.set(false); },
      error: () => { this.cargando.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los ajustes' }); },
    });
  }

  cargarBodegas() {
    this.bodegasService.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => this.bodegas.set(data || []),
    });
  }

  cargarProductos() {
    this.productosService.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => this.productos.set(data || []),
    });
  }

  seleccionar(ajuste: any) {
    this.seleccionado.set(ajuste);
    this.formMae.patchValue({
      concepto: ajuste.concepto || '',
      bodegaId: ajuste.bodegaId || null,
      sn_entrada: ajuste.sn_entrada || 'S',
    });
    this.cargarDetalles(ajuste.invmovmaeid);
  }

  cargarDetalles(maeId: number) {
    this.cargandoDet.set(true);
    this.service.getDet(maeId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => { this.detalles.set(data || []); this.cargandoDet.set(false); },
      error: () => { this.cargandoDet.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los items' }); },
    });
  }

  volver() {
    this.seleccionado.set(null);
    this.detalles.set([]);
  }

  nuevoMae() {
    this.formMae.reset({ concepto: '', bodegaId: null, sn_entrada: 'S' });
    this.formDet.reset({ codbarra: '', productoId: null, descripcion: '', cantidad: 1 });
    this.codBusqueda.set('');
    this.detalles.set([]);
    this.seleccionado.set({ invmovmaeid: 0, sn_procesado: 'N', sn_anulado: 'N', concepto: '', bodegaId: 0 });
  }

  guardarMae() {
    if (this.formMae.invalid) return;
    const val = this.formMae.value;
    this.guardando.set(true);
    this.service.create({
      concepto: val.concepto || '',
      bodegaId: val.bodegaId || 0,
      sn_entrada: val.sn_entrada || 'S',
    }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Creado', detail: 'Ajuste creado' });
        this.seleccionado.set(res);
        this.cargarAjustes();
      },
      error: (err) => { this.guardando.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo crear' }); },
    });
  }

  onCodBarraInput(valor: string) {
    this.codBusqueda.set(valor);
    if (valor.length >= 12) {
      this.buscarProducto();
    }
  }

  buscarProducto() {
    const q = this.codBusqueda().trim();
    if (!q) return;
    const prod = this.productos().find(p => p.codbarra === q);
    if (prod) {
      this.formDet.patchValue({
        productoId: prod.produtoId,
        codbarra: prod.codbarra,
        descripcion: prod.descripcion,
      });
    } else {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'No encontrado', detail: 'Producto no encontrado por código de barras' });
    }
  }

  showHelperProductos() {
    this.ref = this.dialogService.open(ProductosHelperList, {
      header: 'Seleccionar un producto',
      width: '50vw',
      modal: true,
      contentStyle: { overflow: 'auto' },
      breakpoints: { '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' },
      templates: { footer: FooterHelper },
    });
    this.ref.onClose.pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe((data: any) => {
      if (data && 'codbarra' in data) {
        this.seleccionarProducto(data);
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Producto elegido en el helper: se carga en el formulario y se deja el
   * cursor en CANTIDAD para digitarla y confirmar con el botón "+".
   */
  seleccionarProducto(prod: any) {
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae || !mae.invmovmaeid) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atención', detail: 'Primero guarde el encabezado del ajuste' });
      return;
    }
    this.formDet.patchValue({
      productoId: prod.productoId ?? prod.produtoId ?? null,
      codbarra: prod.codbarra,
      descripcion: prod.descripcion,
      cantidad: 1,
    });
    this.codBusqueda.set(prod.codbarra || '');
    setTimeout(() => {
      const input = document.getElementById('cant-ajuste') as HTMLInputElement | null;
      input?.focus();
      input?.select();
    });
  }

  agregarItem() {
    if (this.formDet.invalid) return;
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae || !mae.invmovmaeid) {
      this.msgs.add({ severity: 'warn', summary: 'Atención', detail: 'Primero guarde el encabezado del ajuste' });
      return;
    }
    const val = this.formDet.value;
    this.guardando.set(true);
    this.service.createDet({
      invmovmaeid: mae.invmovmaeid,
      bodegaId: mae.bodegaId,
      codbarra: val.codbarra || '',
      cantidad: val.cantidad || 0,
      sn_entrada: mae.sn_entrada || 'S',
    }).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Agregado', detail: 'Item agregado' });
        this.formDet.reset({ codbarra: '', productoId: null, descripcion: '', cantidad: 1 });
        this.codBusqueda.set('');
        this.cargarDetalles(mae.invmovmaeid);
      },
      error: (err) => { this.guardando.set(false); this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo agregar' }); },
    });
  }

  eliminarItem(row: any) {
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar item "${row.descripcion || row.codbarra}"?`,
      header: 'Confirmar',
      acceptLabel: 'Eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.removeDet(row.invmovdetid).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Eliminado' });
            this.cargarDetalles(this.seleccionado()!.invmovmaeid);
          },
          error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo eliminar' }),
        });
      },
      reject: () => this.confirm.close(),
    });
  }

  procesar() {
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae) return;
    const tipo = mae.sn_entrada === 'S' ? 'entrada' : 'salida';
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Procesar ajuste #${mae.invmovmaeid}? Se registrará como ${tipo} en kardex.`,
      header: 'Procesar ajuste',
      acceptLabel: 'Procesar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.procesar(mae.invmovmaeid).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: (res) => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Procesado', detail: res?.message || 'Ajuste procesado' });
            this.cargarAjustes();
            this.cargarDetalles(mae.invmovmaeid);
          },
          error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo procesar' }),
        });
      },
      reject: () => this.confirm.close(),
    });
  }

  todosProcesados(): boolean {
    return this.detalles().length > 0 && this.detalles().every(d => d.verificador === 1);
  }

  esNuevo(): boolean {
    return !this.seleccionado()?.invmovmaeid;
  }

  nombreBodega(id: number): string {
    return this.bodegas().find(b => b.bodegaId === id)?.descripcion || `Bodega ${id}`;
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Component, OnInit, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { CatalogoParametrosService } from '../../../core/services/catalogo-parametros.service';

export interface CampoColumna {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface CatalogoConfig {
  titulo: string;
  subtitulo: string;
  ruta: string;
  idKey: string;
  icono: string;
  tituloNuevo: string;
  campos: CampoColumna[];
  sinEstado?: boolean;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-catalogo-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule, TooltipModule],
  templateUrl: './catalogo-list.html',
  styleUrl: './catalogo-list.scss',
})
export class CatalogoList implements OnInit {
  private catalogoService = inject(CatalogoParametrosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  config = signal<CatalogoConfig>({
    titulo: '',
    subtitulo: '',
    ruta: '',
    idKey: '',
    icono: '',
    tituloNuevo: '',
    campos: [],
  });

  data = signal<any[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<any[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);
  busqueda = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.route.paramMap.subscribe(() => {
      const data = this.route.snapshot.data?.['catalogo'] as CatalogoConfig;
      if (data) {
        this.config.set(data);
      }
      this.busqueda.set('');
      this.load();
    });
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.catalogoService.getAll<any>(this.config().ruta).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: `No se pudieron cargar ${this.config().titulo}`,
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.busqueda().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((item) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return this.config().campos.some(
          (c) => String(item?.[c.key] ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.busqueda.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id: number) {
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
<p-toast />
<p-confirmDialog />

<section class="page">
  @if (!seleccionado()) {
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>

      <p class="page-subtitle">Órdenes de compra y facturas de proveedores</p>

  <p-table [value]="compras()" [loading]="cargando()" dataKey="compraId" [paginator]="true" [rows]="10"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true" currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 25, 50]" size="small">
    <ng-template pTemplate="header">
      <tr>
        <th style="width:4rem">#</th>
        <th>Fecha</th>
        <th>Proveedor</th>
        <th>Bodega</th>
        <th>Ref.</th>
        <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Total</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Tipo</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Pagada</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Estado</th>
        <th style="width:8rem">Acciones</th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-row>
      <tr (click)="seleccionar(row)" style="cursor:pointer">
        <td>{{ row.compraId }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.fecharegistro | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
        <td>{{ nombreProveedor(row.proveedorId) }}</td>
        <td>{{ nombreBodega(row.bodegaId) }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.nroreferencia || '-' }}</td>
        <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ moneda(row.total) }}</td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.TipoCompra === 'FCO' ? 'Contado' : row.TipoCompra === 'FCC' ? 'Crédito' : 'Orden'"
            [severity]="row.TipoCompra === 'FCO' ? 'success' : row.TipoCompra === 'FCC' ? 'info' : 'warn'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'Sí' : 'No'" [severity]="row.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'success' : 'warn'"
            [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.sn_anulada === 'S' ? 'Anulada' : 'Activa'"
            [severity]="row.sn_anulada === 'S' ? 'danger' : 'success'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" severity="danger" text size="small" rounded
            (onClick)="$event.stopPropagation(); anularCompra(row)" [disabled]="row.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr>
        <td colspan="10" class="text-center p-3">No hay compras registradas.</td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>
  } @else {
  <header class="page-header">
    <div class="flex align-items-center gap-2">
      <p-button icon="pi pi-arrow-left" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="volver()" />
      <div>
        <h3 class="page-title">Compra #{{ seleccionado()!.compraId }}</h3>
        <p class="page-subtitle">
          {{ nombreProveedor(seleccionado()!.proveedorId) }}
          — {{ nombreBodega(seleccionado()!.bodegaId) }}
          — {{ seleccionado()!.TipoCompra === 'FCO' ? 'Contado' : seleccionado()!.TipoCompra === 'FCC' ? 'Crédito' : 'Orden' }}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex gap-2">
      <p-button label="Agregar Item" icon="pi pi-plus" size="small" rounded (onClick)="nuevoDet()"
        [disabled]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
      <p-button label="Procesar" icon="pi pi-check-circle" size="small" rounded severity="success" (onClick)="procesar()"
        [disabled]="detalles().length === 0 || seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
      <p-button label="Anular" icon="pi pi-times-circle" size="small" rounded severity="danger"
        (onClick)="anularCompra(seleccionado()!)" [disabled]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
    </div>
  </header>

  <p-table [value]="detalles()" [loading]="cargandoDet()" dataKey="cxpcomprasdetId" [paginator]="true" [rows]="15"
    size="small">
    <ng-template pTemplate="header">
      <tr>
        <th style="width:3rem">#</th>
        <th style="width:8rem">Cod. Barra</th>
        <th>Producto</th>
        <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Cantidad</th>
        <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Precio U.</th>
        <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Subtotal</th>
        <th style="width:7rem">Acciones</th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-row>
      <tr>
        <td>{{ row.nrofila }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.codbarra }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.descripcion || nombreProducto(row.productoId) }}</td>
        <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ row.cantidad }}</td>
        <td class="text-right">{{ moneda(row.precio) }}</td>
        <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ moneda(row.subtotal) }}</td>
        <td>
          <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" text severity="danger" size="small" rounded (onClick)="eliminarDet(row)"
            [disabled]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr>
        <td colspan="7" class="text-center p-3">No hay items en esta compra.</td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>

  <div class="compra-totales">
    <div class="total-line">
      <span>Total Compra:</span>
      <span class="font-bold">{{ moneda(seleccionado()!.total) }}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="total-line">
      <span>Estado Pago:</span>
      <p-tag [value]="seleccionado()!.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'Pagada' : 'Pendiente'"
        [severity]="seleccionado()!.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'success' : 'warn'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
    </div>
  </div>
  }
</section>

<!-- Dialog Nueva Compra -->
<p-dialog header="Nueva Compra" [modal]="true" [draggable]="false" [resizable]="false" [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }" [style]="{width:'550px', minHeight:'350px'}"
  [(visible)]="dialogMae">
  <form [formGroup]="formMae" class="flex flex-column gap-3">
    <div class="form-grid-2">
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Proveedor *</label>
        <p-select formControlName="proveedorId" [options]="proveedores()" optionLabel="nombres"
          optionValue="proveedorId" placeholder="Seleccionar proveedor" [filter]="true"
          [filterBy]="'nombres,apellidos,razonsocial'" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'">
          <ng-template let-prov pTemplate="item">
            <span>{{ prov.nombres }} {{ prov.apellidos }}</span>
          </ng-template>
        </p-select>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Bodega *</label>
        <p-select formControlName="bodegaId" [options]="bodegas()" optionLabel="descripcion" optionValue="bodegaId"
          placeholder="Seleccionar bodega" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'" />
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="form-grid-2">
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Tipo de Compra *</label>
        <p-select formControlName="TipoCompra"
          [options]="[{label:'Factura de contado', value:'FCO'},{label:'Factura al crédito', value:'FCC'},{label:'Orden de compra', value:'ORC'}]" optionLabel="label"
          optionValue="value" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Documento Fiscal</label>
        <p-select formControlName="documentoId" [options]="documentosFiscales()" optionLabel="label" optionValue="value"
          placeholder="Seleccionar documento" styleClass="w-full" [showClear]="true" [appendTo]="'body'" />
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="form-grid-2">
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Moneda *</label>
        <p-select formControlName="monedaId" [options]="monedas()" optionLabel="label" optionValue="value"
          placeholder="Seleccionar moneda" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Nro. Referencia</label>
        <input pInputText formControlName="nroreferencia" class="w-full"
          placeholder="Nro. factura o referencia del proveedor" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
  <ng-template pTemplate="footer">
    <p-button label="Cancelar" severity="secondary" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="dialogMae.set(false)" />
    <p-button label="Crear Compra" icon="pi pi-check" size="small" rounded severity="success" [raised]="true" (onClick)="guardarMae()" [disabled]="formMae.invalid" />
  </ng-template>
</p-dialog>

<!-- Dialog Agregar Item -->
<p-dialog header="Agregar Producto" [modal]="true" [draggable]="false" [resizable]="false" [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }" [style]="{width:'500px', minHeight:'350px'}"
  [(visible)]="dialogDet">
  <form [formGroup]="formDet" class="flex flex-column gap-3">
    <div>
      <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Producto *</label>
      <p-select formControlName="productoId" [options]="productos()" optionLabel="descripcion" optionValue="produtoId"
        placeholder="Buscar producto..." [filter]="true" [filterBy]="'descripcion,codbarra'" styleClass="w-full"
        [showClear]="true" [appendTo]="'body'">
        <ng-template let-prod pTemplate="item">
          <div class="flex flex-column">
            <span class="text-sm font-medium">{{ prod.descripcion }}</span>
            <span class="text-xs text-color-secondary">{{ prod.codbarra }} — L {{ prod.cstounit | number:'1.2-2'
              }}</span>
          </div>
        </ng-template>
      </p-select>
    </div>
    <div class="form-grid-2">
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Cantidad *</label>
        <p-inputNumber formControlName="cantidad" [min]="0.01" mode="decimal" [minFractionDigits]="2"
          [maxFractionDigits]="2" size="small" [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }" styleClass="w-full" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Precio Unitario *</label>
        <p-inputNumber formControlName="precio" [min]="0.01" mode="currency" currency="HNL" [locale]="'es-HN'"
          [minFractionDigits]="2" [maxFractionDigits]="2" [useGrouping]="true" size="small"
          [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }" styleClass="w-full" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
  <ng-template pTemplate="footer">
    <p-button label="Cancelar" severity="secondary" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="dialogDet.set(false)" />
    <p-button label="Agregar" icon="pi pi-check" size="small" rounded severity="success" [raised]="true" (onClick)="guardarDet()" [disabled]="formDet.invalid" />
  </ng-template>
</p-dialog>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\consulta-compras\consulta-compras.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef, ChangeDetectionStrategy } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { DialogModule } from 'primeng/dialog';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { ToastModule } from 'primeng/toast';
import { ConfirmDialogModule } from 'primeng/confirmdialog';
import { ToolbarModule } from 'primeng/toolbar';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { CxpService } from '../../../core/services/cxp.service';
import { BodegasService } from '../../../core/services/bodegas.service';
import { ProductosService } from '../../../core/services/productos.service';
import { CatalogoParametrosService } from '../../../core/services/catalogo-parametros.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { CompraMae, CompraDet, Proveedor, Producto, Bodega } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-consulta-compras',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule, FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule,
    TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, InputNumberModule,
    DialogModule, TagModule, ToastModule, ConfirmDialogModule,
    ToolbarModule, SelectModule, TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './consulta-compras.html',
  styleUrl: './consulta-compras.scss',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ConsultaCompras implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private service = inject(CxpService);
  private bodegasService = inject(BodegasService);
  private productosService = inject(ProductosService);
  private catalogService = inject(CatalogoParametrosService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private router = inject(Router);

  compras = signal<CompraMae[]>([]);
  detalles = signal<CompraDet[]>([]);
  proveedores = signal<Proveedor[]>([]);
  bodegas = signal<Bodega[]>([]);
  productos = signal<Producto[]>([]);
  documentosFiscales = signal<{ label: string; value: number }[]>([]);
  monedas = signal<{ label: string; value: number }[]>([]);

  seleccionado = signal<CompraMae | null>(null);
  cargando = signal(false);
  cargandoDet = signal(false);

  dialogMae = signal(false);
  dialogDet = signal(false);
  esEdicion = signal(false);

  totalFactura = signal(0);

  formMae = this.fb.group({
    proveedorId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    bodegaId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    TipoCompra: ['FCO' as 'FCO' | 'FCC' | 'ORC', Validators.required],
    documentoId: [null as number | null],
    monedaId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    nroreferencia: [''],
    subtotal: [0],
    descuento: [0],
    impuesto: [0],
    total: [0],
  });

  formDet = this.fb.group({
    productoId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    precio: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
  });

  ngOnInit() {
    this.cargarCompras();
    this.cargarProveedores();
    this.cargarBodegas();
    this.cargarProductos();
    this.cargarDocumentosFiscales();
    this.cargarMonedas();
  }

  cargarCompras() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getCompras().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.compras.set(data || []);
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las compras' });
      },
    });
  }

  cargarProveedores() {
    this.service.getProveedores().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => this.proveedores.set(data || []),
    });
  }

  cargarBodegas() {
    this.bodegasService.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data: any) => this.bodegas.set(data?.value || data || []),
    });
  }

  cargarProductos() {
    this.productosService.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data: any) => this.productos.set(data?.value || data || []),
    });
  }

  cargarDocumentosFiscales() {
    this.catalogService.getAll<any>('/parametros/tcotipodocumentofiscal').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        const user = this.auth.currentUser();
        const filtered = (res || []).filter((r: any) => {
          const activo = r.sn_activo === 'S';
          const mismaEmpresa = user?.empresaId ? Number(r.empresaId) === Number(user.empresaId) : true;
          return activo && mismaEmpresa;
        });
        this.documentosFiscales.set(filtered.map((r: any) => ({
          label: r.descripcion,
          value: r.tipodocumentofiscalId,
        })));
      },
    });
  }

  cargarMonedas() {
    this.catalogService.getAll<any>('/parametros/monedas').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        const user = this.auth.currentUser();
        const filtered = (res || []).filter((r: any) => {
          const mismaEmpresa = user?.empresaId ? Number(r.empresaId) === Number(user.empresaId) : true;
          return mismaEmpresa;
        });
        this.monedas.set(filtered.map((r: any) => ({
          label: r.descripcion,
          value: r.monedaId,
        })));
      },
    });
  }

  seleccionar(compra: CompraMae) {
    this.seleccionado.set(compra);
    this.cargarDetalles(compra.compraId);
  }

  cargarDetalles(compraId: number) {
    this.cargandoDet.set(true);
    this.service.getDetallesByCompra(compraId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.detalles.set(data || []);
        this.cargandoDet.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargandoDet.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los detalles' });
      },
    });
  }

  volver() {
    this.seleccionado.set(null);
    this.detalles.set([]);
  }

  nuevoMae() {
    this.router.navigate(['/cxp/compras']);
  }

  guardarMae() {
    if (this.formMae.invalid) return;
    const val = this.formMae.value;
    const payload: any = {
      ...val,
      sn_pagada: 'N',
      sn_anulada: 'N',
    };

    this.service.createCompra(payload).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Guardado', detail: 'Compra creada exitosamente' });
        this.dialogMae.set(false);
        this.cargarCompras();
        if (res?.compraId) {
          this.seleccionar(res);
        }
      },
      error: (err) => {
        const detail = err.error?.message || 'No se pudo crear la compra';
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail });
      },
    });
  }

  nuevoDet() {
    this.formDet.reset({ productoId: null, cantidad: 1, precio: 0 });
    this.dialogDet.set(true);
  }

  guardarDet() {
    if (this.formDet.invalid) return;
    const val = this.formDet.value;
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae) return;

    const producto = this.productos().find(p => p.produtoId === val.productoId);
    const payload: any = {
      compraId: mae.compraId,
      bodegaId: mae.bodegaId,
      codbarra: producto?.codbarra || '',
      descripcion: producto?.descripcion || '',
      cantidad: val.cantidad || 1,
      precio: val.precio || 0,
      subtotal: (val.cantidad || 1) * (val.precio || 0),
      empresaId: mae.empresaId,
    };

    this.service.createCompraDet(payload).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Guardado', detail: 'Item agregado' });
        this.dialogDet.set(false);
        this.cargarDetalles(mae.compraId);
      },
      error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo guardar el item' }),
    });
  }

  eliminarDet(row: CompraDet) {
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar item "${row.descripcion || row.codbarra}"?`,
      header: 'Confirmar',
      acceptLabel: 'Eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.deleteCompraDet(row.cxpcomprasdetId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Eliminado' });
            this.cargarDetalles(this.seleccionado()!.compraId);
          },
          error: (err) => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo eliminar' });
          },
        });
      },
      reject: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
      },
    });
  }

  procesar() {
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae) return;
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Procesar compra #${mae.compraId}? Se registrará entrada en kardex y movimiento CxP (débito).`,
      header: 'Procesar compra',
      acceptLabel: 'Procesar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.procesarCompra(mae.compraId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: (res: any) => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Procesada', detail: res?.message || 'Compra procesada' });
            this.cargarCompras();
            this.cargarDetalles(mae.compraId);
          },
          error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo procesar' }),
        });
      },
      reject: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
      },
    });
  }

  anularCompra(compra: CompraMae) {
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Anular compra #${compra.compraId}? Se reversará el kardex y se marcará el movimiento CxP como anulado.`,
      header: 'Anular compra',
      acceptLabel: 'Anular',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.anularCompra(compra.compraId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: (res: any) => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Anulada', detail: res?.message || 'Compra anulada' });
            this.cargarCompras();
            if (this.seleccionado()?.compraId === compra.compraId) {
              this.volver();
            }
          },
          error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo anular' }),
        });
      },
      reject: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
      },
    });
  }

  nombreProveedor(id: number): string {
    const p = this.proveedores().find(x => x.proveedorId === id);
    return p ? `${p.nombres} ${p.apellidos}` : `Proveedor #${id}`;
  }

  nombreBodega(id: number): string {
    return this.bodegas().find(b => b.bodegaId === id)?.descripcion || `Bodega ${id}`;
  }

  nombreProducto(id: number): string {
    return this.productos().find(p => p.produtoId === id)?.descripcion || `Producto #${id}`;
  }

  moneda(val: number): string {
    if (val == null || isNaN(val)) return 'L 0.00';
    return val.toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }

  actualizarTotales() {
    const sub = this.detalles().reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.subtotal || 0), 0);
    this.totalFactura.set(sub);
  }
}
```

```typescript
<section class="page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1 class="page-title">Existencias</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Consultar existencias por producto y bodega</p>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="filtros card">
    <div class="campo">
      <label>Buscar</label>
      <input
        pInputText
        type="text"
        placeholder="Producto, bodega..."
        [ngModel]="q()"
        (ngModelChange)="q.set($event)"
        (keyup.enter)="buscar()"
      />
    </div>
    <div class="campo acciones">
      <p-button label="Buscar" icon="pi pi-search" size="small" rounded (onClick)="buscar()" />
      <p-button
        label="Limpiar"
        icon="pi pi-times"
        severity="secondary"
        text
        size="small"
        rounded
        (onClick)="limpiarFiltros()"
      />
    </div>
  </div>

  <p-table
    [value]="filtered()"
    [loading]="cargando()"
    dataKey="productoId"
    [expandedRowKeys]="expandedRows()"
    [paginator]="true"
    [rows]="10"
    size="small"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 20, 50]"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
    currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
    [tableStyle]="{ 'min-width': '60rem' }"
  >
    <ng-template pTemplate="header">
      <tr>
        <th style="width: 3rem"></th>
        <th>Imagen</th>
        <th>Código</th>
        <th>Descripción</th>
        <th class="text-right">Precio Vta.</th>
        <th>Disponibilidad</th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-rowData let-expanded="expanded">
      <tr>
        <td>
          <button
            type="button"
            pButton
            [icon]="expanded ? 'pi pi-chevron-down' : 'pi pi-chevron-right'"
            class="p-button-text p-button-sm p-button-rounded"
            (click)="toggleRow(rowData)"
          ></button>
        </td>
        <td>
          @if (getItemImagen(rowData)) {
            <img [src]="getItemImagen(rowData)" [alt]="rowData.descripcion" class="img-thumb" loading="lazy"
              (mouseenter)="onImgHover(getItemImagen(rowData), $event)" (mousemove)="onImgMove($event)" (mouseleave)="onImgLeave()" />
          } @else {
            <div class="img-placeholder"><i class="pi pi-image"></i></div>
          }
        </td>
        <td><span class="font-semibold">{{ rowData.codbarra }}</span></td>
        <td>{{ rowData.descripcion }}</td>
        <td class="text-right">{{ moneda(rowData.precioventa) }}</td>
        <td>
          <p-tag
            [value]="rowData.disponibilidad"
            [severity]="rowData.disponibilidad === 'Alta' ? 'success' : 'danger'"
            styleClass="tag-sm"
          />
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="expandedrow" let-rowData>
      <tr class="expanded-detail">
        <td colspan="6">
          <div class="expansion-content">
            <p class="expansion-title">Existencias por bodega</p>
            <div class="bodegas-grid">
              @for (b of rowData.bodegas; track b.bodegaId) {
                <div class="bodega-card">
                  <span class="bodega-nombre">{{ b.descripcion }}</span>
                  <span class="bodega-existencia" [class.agotado]="b.existencia === 0"> existencia {{ b.existencia }}</span>
                </div>
              }
            </div>
          </div>
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr>
        <td colspan="6" class="text-center p-3">No hay existencias registradas.</td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>

  @if (zoomVisible()) {
    <img [src]="zoomUrl()" class="img-zoom-overlay" [style.left.px]="zoomX()" [style.top.px]="zoomY()" />
  }
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\existencias\existencias.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ExistenciasService } from '../../../core/services/existencias.service';
import { BodegasService } from '../../../core/services/bodegas.service';
import { ApiService } from '../../../core/services/api.service';
import { forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

export interface ProductoExistencia {
  productoId: number;
  codbarra: string;
  descripcion: string;
  precioventa: number;
  imagen: string | null;
  disponibilidad: 'Alta' | 'Baja';
  bodegas: { bodegaId: number; descripcion: string; existencia: number }[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-existencias',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule],
  templateUrl: './existencias.html',
  styleUrl: './existencias.scss',
})
export class Existencias implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(ExistenciasService);
  private bodegasService = inject(BodegasService);
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<ProductoExistencia[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<ProductoExistencia[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);
  q = signal('');
  expandedRows = signal<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  // Zoom imagen
  zoomVisible = signal(false);
  zoomUrl = signal('');
  zoomX = signal(0);
  zoomY = signal(0);

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    forkJoin([
      this.service.getAll(),
      this.api.get<any[]>('/inventario/tienda/productos'),
      this.bodegasService.getAll(),
    ]).subscribe({
      next: ([existencias, productos, bodegas]) => {
        const mapa = new Map<number, ProductoExistencia>();

        for (const e of existencias) {
          if (!mapa.has(e.productoId)) {
            const prod = productos.find((p: any) => p.produtoId === e.productoId);
            mapa.set(e.productoId, {
              productoId: e.productoId,
              codbarra: prod?.codbarra || '',
              descripcion: prod?.descripcion || '',
              precioventa: Number(prod?.precioventa) || 0,
              imagen: prod?.imagen || null,
              disponibilidad: 'Baja',
              bodegas: [],
            });
          }

          const bodega = bodegas.find((b: any) => b.bodegaId === e.bodegaId);
          const entry = mapa.get(e.productoId)!;
          entry.bodegas.push({
            bodegaId: e.bodegaId,
            descripcion: bodega?.descripcion || `Bodega ${e.bodegaId}`,
            existencia: Number(e.existencia) || 0,
          });
        }

        const totalExistencia = (p: ProductoExistencia) =>
          p.bodegas.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.existencia, 0);

        for (const entry of mapa.values()) {
          entry.disponibilidad = totalExistencia(entry) >= 50 ? 'Alta' : 'Baja';
        }

        const resultado = Array.from(mapa.values());
        this.data.set(resultado);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los datos',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((e) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return (
          e.codbarra?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.descripcion?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.bodegas.some((b) => b.descripcion?.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  toggleRow(rowData: ProductoExistencia) {
    const key = rowData.productoId;
    const current = { ...this.expandedRows() };
    if (current[key]) {
      delete current[key];
    } else {
      current[key] = true;
    }
    this.expandedRows.set(current);
  }

  totalExistencia(p: ProductoExistencia): number {
    return p.bodegas.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.existencia, 0);
  }

  resolverImagen(imagen: string | null): string {
    if (!imagen) return '';
    return /^data:/i.test(imagen) ? imagen : `data:image/png;base64,${imagen}`;
  }

  getItemImagen(item: ProductoExistencia): string {
    if (item.imagen) return this.resolverImagen(item.imagen);
    return '';
  }

  onImgHover(url: string, event: MouseEvent) {
    this.zoomUrl.set(url);
    this.zoomX.set(event.clientX + 12);
    this.zoomY.set(event.clientY - 100);
    this.zoomVisible.set(true);
  }

  onImgMove(event: MouseEvent) {
    this.zoomX.set(event.clientX + 12);
    this.zoomY.set(event.clientY - 100);
  }

  onImgLeave() {
    this.zoomVisible.set(false);
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'HNL',
    });
  }
}

```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\kardex\kardex.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { KardexService } from '../../../core/services/kardex.service';
import { Kardex as KardexMov } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-kardex',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule],
  templateUrl: './kardex.html',
  styleUrl: './kardex.scss',
})
export class Kardex implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(KardexService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<KardexMov[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<KardexMov[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los movimientos de kardex',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((k) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return (
          k.codbarra?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          k.nroreferencia?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          String(k.productoId).includes(q)
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'HNL',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
              <input
                pInputText
                pSize="small"
                id="descripcion_corta"
                formControlName="descripcion_corta"
                maxlength="50"
                placeholder="Nombre corto"
              />
            </div>

            <div class="campo">
              <label for="codigo_sku">SKU <span class="req">*</span></label>
              <input
                pInputText
                pSize="small"
                id="codigo_sku"
                formControlName="codigo_sku"
                maxlength="20"
                placeholder="Código interno (SKU)"
                [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('codigo_sku') }"
              />
              @if (invalid('codigo_sku')) {
              <small class="err">El SKU es obligatorio</small>
              }
            </div>

            <div class="campo">
              <label for="codbarra">Código de barras</label>
              <input
                pInputText
                pSize="small"
                id="codbarra"
                formControlName="codbarra"
                maxlength="20"
                placeholder="Código de barras"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Accordion: Costos y Precio de Venta -->
        <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['0']">
          <p-accordion-panel value="0">
            <p-accordion-header>Costos y Precio de Venta del producto</p-accordion-header>
            <p-accordion-content>
              <div class="p-fluid">
                <div class="form-grid-2">
                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="cstounit">Costo unitario</label>
                    <p-inputnumber
                      size="small"
                      id="cstounit"
                      formControlName="cstounit"
                      mode="currency"
                      currency="HNL"
                      [locale]="'es-HN'"
                      [minFractionDigits]="2"
                      [maxFractionDigits]="2"
                      [useGrouping]="true"
                      [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="cstoprom">Costo promedio</label>
                    <p-inputnumber
                      size="small"
                      id="cstoprom"
                      formControlName="cstoprom"
                      mode="currency"
                      currency="HNL"
                      [locale]="'es-HN'"
                      [minFractionDigits]="2"
                      [maxFractionDigits]="2"
                      [useGrouping]="true"
                      [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="puntoretorno">Punto de retorno</label>
                    <p-inputnumber
                      size="small"
                      id="puntoretorno"
                      formControlName="puntoretorno"
                      mode="currency"
                      currency="HNL"
                      [locale]="'es-HN'"
                      [minFractionDigits]="2"
                      [maxFractionDigits]="2"
                      [useGrouping]="true"
                      [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="precioventa">Precio de venta</label>
                    <p-inputnumber
                      size="small"
                      id="precioventa"
                      formControlName="precioventa"
                      mode="currency"
                      currency="HNL"
                      [locale]="'es-HN'"
                      [minFractionDigits]="2"
                      [maxFractionDigits]="2"
                      [useGrouping]="true"
                      [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </p-accordion-content>
          </p-accordion-panel>
        </p-accordion>


        <!-- Accordion: Departamento, Categoría, Marca, Pasillo, Estado -->
        <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['0']">
          <p-accordion-panel value="0">
            <p-accordion-header
              >Atributos de Departamento, Categoría, Marca, Pasillo</p-accordion-header
            >
            <p-accordion-content>
              <div class="p-fluid">
                <div class="form-grid-2">
                  <div class="campo">
                    <!-- 20261015 ARFM select real de departamentos (tinvdeptos) -->
                    <label for="deptoId">Departamento <span class="req">*</span></label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      id="deptoId"
                      formControlName="deptoId"
                      [options]="departamentos()"
                      optionLabel="descripcion"
                      optionValue="deptoId"
                      placeholder="Seleccione un departamento"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [showClear]="true"
                      [loading]="departamentosCargando()"
                      [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('deptoId') }"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                    />
                    @if (invalid('deptoId')) {
                    <small class="err">Seleccione un departamento</small>
                    }
                  </div>

                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="categoriaId">Categoría <span class="req">*</span></label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      id="categoriaId"
                      formControlName="categoriaId"
                      [options]="categorias()"
                      optionLabel="descripcion"
                      optionValue="categoriaId"
                      placeholder="Seleccione categoría"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [showClear]="true"
                      [loading]="categoriasCargando()"
                      [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('categoriaId') }"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                    />
                    @if (invalid('categoriaId')) {
                    <small class="err">Seleccione una categoría</small>
                    }
                  </div>

                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="marcaId">Marca <span class="req">*</span></label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      id="marcaId"
                      formControlName="marcaId"
                      [options]="marcas()"
                      optionLabel="descripcion"
                      optionValue="marcaId"
                      placeholder="Seleccione una marca"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [showClear]="true"
                      [loading]="marcasCargando()"
                      [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('marcaId') }"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                    />
                    @if (invalid('marcaId')) {
                    <small class="err">Seleccione una marca</small>
                    }
                  </div>

                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="pasilloId">Pasillo <span class="req">*</span></label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      id="pasilloId"
                      formControlName="pasilloId"
                      [options]="pasillos()"
                      optionLabel="descripcion"
                      optionValue="pasilloId"
                      placeholder="Seleccione un pasillo"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [showClear]="true"
                      [loading]="pasillosCargando()"
                      [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('pasilloId') }"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                    />
                    @if (invalid('pasilloId')) {
                    <small class="err">Seleccione un pasillo</small>
                    }
                  </div>

                </div>
              </div>
            </p-accordion-content>
          </p-accordion-panel>
        </p-accordion>

        <!-- Accordion: Farmacias -->

        <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['0']">
          <p-accordion-panel value="0">
            <p-accordion-header>Atributo de Farmacias</p-accordion-header>
            <p-accordion-content>
              <div class="p-fluid">
                <div class="form-grid-2">
                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="sn_controlado">Control</label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      id="sn_controlado"
                      formControlName="sn_controlado"
                      [options]="snControladoOptions"
                      optionLabel="label"
                      optionValue="value"
                      placeholder="Producto controlado"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="sn_droga">Droga / Psicotrópico</label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      id="sn_droga"
                      formControlName="sn_droga"
                      [options]="snControladoOptions"
                      optionLabel="label"
                      optionValue="value"
                      placeholder="Regulado como droga"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="sn_valida_lote">Valida Lote / Vencimiento</label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      id="sn_valida_lote"
                      formControlName="sn_valida_lote"
                      [options]="snValidarOptions"
                      optionLabel="label"
                      optionValue="value"
                      placeholder="Valida lote"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </p-accordion-content>
          </p-accordion-panel>
        </p-accordion>

        <!-- Accordion: Restaurante -->

        <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['0']">
          <p-accordion-panel value="0">
            <p-accordion-header>Atributo de restaurante</p-accordion-header>
            <p-accordion-content>
              <div class="p-fluid">
                <div class="campo">
                  <label for="sn_enviar_a_cocina">Enviar a Cocina</label>
                  <p-select
                    size="small"
                    id="sn_enviar_a_cocina"
                    formControlName="sn_enviar_a_cocina"
                    [options]="snValidarOptions"
                    optionLabel="label"
                    optionValue="value"
                    placeholder="Enviar a cocina"
                    styleClass="w-full"
                    [appendTo]="'body'"
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="p-fluid"></div>
              </div>
            </p-accordion-content>
          </p-accordion-panel>
        </p-accordion>

        <!-- Accordion: Impuesto -->
        <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['0']">
          <p-accordion-panel value="0">
            <p-accordion-header>Impuesto del producto</p-accordion-header>
            <p-accordion-content>
              <div class="p-fluid">
                <div class="form-grid-2">
                  <div class="campo">
                    <label for="impuestoId">Impuesto <span class="req">*</span></label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      id="impuestoId"
                      formControlName="impuestoId"
                      [options]="impuestos()"
                      optionLabel="descripcion"
                      optionValue="impuestoId"
                      placeholder="Seleccionar impuesto"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                      [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('impuestoId') }"
                    />
                    @if (invalid('impuestoId')) {
                    <small class="err">Seleccione un impuesto</small>
                    }
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </p-accordion-content>
          </p-accordion-panel>
        </p-accordion>

        <!-- Accordion: Estado -->
        <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['0']">
          <p-accordion-panel value="0">
            <p-accordion-header>Estado del producto</p-accordion-header>
            <p-accordion-content>
              <div class="p-fluid">
                <div class="form-grid-2">
                  @if (esEdicion()) {
                  <div class="campo">
                    <label>Estado <span class="req">*</span></label>
                    <p-select
                      size="small"
                      [options]="snOptions"
                      formControlName="sn_activo"
                      optionLabel="label"
                      optionValue="value"
                      placeholder="Estado"
                      styleClass="w-full"
                      [appendTo]="'body'"
                    />
                  </div>
                  }

                </div>
              </div>
            </p-accordion-content>
          </p-accordion-panel>
        </p-accordion>


        <!-- Acciones -->
        <div class="acciones-form">
          <p-button
            type="button"
            label="Cancelar"
            icon="pi pi-times"
            severity="secondary"
            size="small"
            rounded
            (onClick)="volver()"
          />
          <p-button
            type="submit"
            label="Guardar"
            icon="pi pi-check"
            rounded
            size="small"
            [loading]="guardando()"
          />
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>

    <!-- ═══════════════ COLUMNA DERECHA ═══════════════ -->
    <div class="producto-col-der">
      <!-- Imágenes -->
      <div class="card mb-3">
        <div class="img-header">
          <div>
            <h3 class="card-title">Imágenes del Producto</h3>
            <p class="card-hint">Máximo {{ MAX_IMAGENES }} imágenes. Formato JPG/PNG.</p>
          </div>
          @if (puedeAgregarImagen) {
          <p-button
            size="small"
            icon="pi pi-plus"
            label="Agregar"
            severity="success"
            variant="text"
            [rounded]="true"
            (click)="fileInput.click()"
          />
          }
        </div>
        <input
          #fileInput
          type="file"
          accept="image/*"
          hidden
          (change)="onSeleccionarImagen($event, imagenesCount)"
        />

        @if (imagenes().length > 0) {
        <p-galleria
          [(value)]="imagenes"
          [activeIndex]="activeIndex()"
          (onActiveIndexChange)="activeIndex.set($event)"
          [showThumbnails]="true"
          [showItemNavigators]="true"
          [circular]="true"
          [numVisible]="5"
          [thumbnailsPosition]="'left'"
          [containerStyle]="{ 'max-width': '98%' }"
          styleClass="producto-galleria"
        >
          <ng-template #item let-item>
            <div class="galleria-item">
              <img [src]="getImagenUrl(item)" style="width: 100%; display: block" />
            </div>
          </ng-template>
          <ng-template #thumbnail let-item>
            <div class="galleria-thumb">
              <img [src]="getImagenUrl(item)" />
              <button
                type="button"
                class="galleria-thumb-remove"
                (click)="eliminarImagen(item); $event.stopPropagation()"
                pTooltip="Eliminar"
              >
                <i class="pi pi-times"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          </ng-template>
        </p-galleria>
        } @else {
        <div class="img-empty-state" (click)="fileInput.click()">
          <i class="pi pi-images"></i>
          <span>Sin imágenes — clic para agregar</span>
        </div>
        }
      </div>

      <!-- Fieldset: Información Específica -->
      <div class="fieldset-wrapper">
        <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['1']">
          <p-accordion-panel value="1">
            <p-accordion-header>Información adicional</p-accordion-header>
            <p-accordion-content>
              <!-- Formulario de atributo -->
              <div class="atributo-form" [formGroup]="atributoForm">
                <div class="p-fluid">
                  <div class="form-grid-3">
                    <div class="campo">
                      <label>Tipo <span class="req">*</span></label>
                      <p-select
                        size="small"
                        formControlName="tipo"
                        [options]="TIPOS_OPTIONS"
                        optionLabel="label"
                        optionValue="value"
                        placeholder="Seleccione tipo"
                        styleClass="w-full"
                        [appendTo]="'body'"
                        [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalidAtributo('tipo') }"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div class="campo">
                      <label>Descripción <span class="req">*</span></label>
                      <input
                        pInputText
                        pSize="small"
                        formControlName="descripcion"
                        maxlength="30"
                        placeholder="Descripción"
                        [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalidAtributo('descripcion') }"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div class="campo">
                      <label>Estado</label>
                      <p-select
                        size="small"
                        formControlName="sn_activo"
                        [options]="snOptions"
                        optionLabel="label"
                        optionValue="value"
                        placeholder="Estado"
                        styleClass="w-full"
                        [appendTo]="'body'"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div class="atributo-acciones">
                    <p-button
                      size="small"
                      label="Limpiar"
                      icon="pi pi-times"
                      severity="secondary"
                      variant="text"
                      [rounded]="true"
                      (onClick)="cancelarAtributo()"
                    />
                    <p-button
                      size="small"
                      [label]="atributoEditando() ? 'Actualizar' : 'Agregar'"
                      [icon]="atributoEditando() ? 'pi pi-check' : 'pi pi-plus'"
                      severity="success"
                      variant="text"
                      [raised]="true"
                      [rounded]="true"
                      [loading]="guardandoAtributo()"
                      (onClick)="guardarAtributo()"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Tabla de atributos -->
              @if (atributos().length > 0) {
              <p-table
                id="gridinfoadd"
                [value]="atributos()"
                size="small"
                [paginator]="true"
                [rows]="5"
                [rowsPerPageOptions]="[5, 10, 25]"
                [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
                currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
              >
                <ng-template pTemplate="header">
                  <tr>
                    <th style="width: 30%">Tipo</th>
                    <th>Descripción</th>
                    <th style="width: 15%">Estado</th>
                    <th style="width: 15%">Acciones</th>
                  </tr>
                </ng-template>
                <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-attr>
                  <tr>
                    <td>
                      <span>{{ getTipoLabel(attr.tipo) }}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{{ attr.descripcion }}</td>
                    <td>
                      @if (attr.sn_activo === 'S') {

                      <p-badge value="Activo" severity="success" badgeSize="small" />
                      } @else {
                      <p-badge value="Inactivo" severity="warn" badgeSize="small" />
                      }
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <div class="d-flex gap-1">
                        <p-button
                          size="small"
                          icon="pi pi-pencil"
                          severity="warn"
                          variant="text"
                          [rounded]="true"
                          pTooltip="Editar"
                          (onClick)="editarAtributo(attr)"
                        />
                        <p-button
                          size="small"
                          icon="pi pi-trash"
                          severity="danger"
                          variant="text"
                          [rounded]="true"
                          pTooltip="Eliminar"
                          (onClick)="eliminarAtributo(attr)"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </ng-template>
              </p-table>
              } @else {
              <p class="text-muted text-center">Sin atributos registrados</p>
              }
            </p-accordion-content>
          </p-accordion-panel>
        </p-accordion>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  }
</section>

```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\productos\producto-form.scss

```typescript
/* ═══════════════ Layout principal ═══════════════ */
.producto-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 45% 55%;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  align-items: start;

  @media (max-width: 960px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.producto-col-izq {
  min-width: 0;
}

.producto-col-der {
  position: sticky;
  top: 5rem;

  @media (max-width: 960px) {
    position: static;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Cards ═══════════════ */
.card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.card-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--c-text);
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
}

.card-hint {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
}

.mb-3 {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

/* ═══════════════ Campos ═══════════════ */
.campo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  width: 90%;

  label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--color-texto-label);
  }

  .req {
    color: #ef4444;
  }

  .err {
    color: #ef4444;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }

  ::ng-deep {
    .p-select {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .p-inputnumber {
      width: 100%;
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Grid 2 columnas dentro de accordion ═══════════════ */
.form-grid-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem 1.25rem;

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Acciones ═══════════════ */
.acciones-form {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}

/* ═══════════════ Grid 3 columnas para form atributo ═══════════════ */
.form-grid-3 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem 1rem;

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Atributos Fieldset ═══════════════ */
.atributo-form {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  width: 78%;
}

.atributo-acciones {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.tag-tipo {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--c-primary);
  color: white;
}

.badge-activo {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: #dcfce7;
  color: #166534;
}

.badge-inactivo {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: #fee2e2;
  color: #991b1b;
}

.d-flex {
  display: flex;
}

.gap-1 {
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.text-muted {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ═══════════════ Fieldset wrapper ═══════════════ */
.fieldset-wrapper {
  width: 98%;
}

/* ═══════════════ PrimeNG Fieldset override ═══════════════ */
::ng-deep .p-fieldset {
  .p-fieldset-legend {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  }

  .p-fieldset-content {
    padding: 0.75rem;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ PrimeNG Table en fieldset ═══════════════ */
::ng-deep .p-fieldset .p-datatable {
  .p-datatable-thead > tr > th {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
  }

  .p-datatable-tbody > tr > td {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Imágenes ═══════════════ */
.img-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;

  .card-title, .card-hint {
    margin: 0;
  }
}

.img-empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  border: 2px dashed var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: var(--c-surface-ground);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;

  i {
    font-size: 2rem;
  }

  span {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }

  &:hover {

}
```

```typescript
  COLOR: 'Color',

};

/** Tipos de atributo disponibles */

@Component({
```
